meaning_hi: Abdicate = सत्ता/पद से त्याग करना; Abrogate = कानून या संधि रद्द करना
meaning_en: Abdicate = to give up power or responsibility; Abrogate = to formally annul a law or agreement
example: The king chose to abdicate; the new government moved to abrogate the controversial treaty.

meaning_hi: Aberrant = असामान्य; Abhorrent = घृणित
meaning_en: Aberrant = departing from what is normal; Abhorrent = causing hatred or disgust
example: His aberrant behaviour was abhorrent to all who witnessed it.

meaning_hi: Abject = अत्यंत दयनीय; Object = वस्तु / आपत्ति करना
meaning_en: Abject = wretched and lacking dignity; Object = a thing, or to express opposition
example: The villagers lived in abject poverty; no one dared to object to the landlord's demands.

meaning_hi: Abstain = दूर रहना (मतदान / खाने-पीने से); Refrain = रोकना (किसी कार्य से)
meaning_en: Abstain = to restrain oneself from voting or indulging; Refrain = to hold back from an action
example: Three members abstained from the vote; all were asked to refrain from commenting to the press.

meaning_hi: Accede = सहमत होना / पद ग्रहण करना; Exceed = सीमा पार करना
meaning_en: Accede = to agree or to assume an office; Exceed = to go beyond a limit
example: He acceded to the demands but refused to exceed his constitutional authority.

meaning_hi: Accept = स्वीकार करना; Except = को छोड़कर
meaning_en: Accept (verb) = to receive or agree; Except (preposition/conjunction) = excluding
example: Everyone accepted the offer except Rahul, who had reservations about the terms.

meaning_hi: Access = पहुँच / उपयोग करना; Excess = अत्यधिक / अधिकता
meaning_en: Access = the means or right to use something; Excess = more than what is needed or allowed
example: She gained access to the files but found them excessive in number.

meaning_hi: Acerbic = कड़वा/तीखा (वाणी में); Ascetic = तपस्वी (कठोर जीवन शैली)
meaning_en: Acerbic = sharp and forthright in speech; Ascetic = living a life of severe self-discipline
example: The ascetic monk had an acerbic wit that cut through pretension effortlessly.

meaning_hi: Acquiesce = बिना विरोध मान लेना; Acquire = प्राप्त करना
meaning_en: Acquiesce = to accept reluctantly without protest; Acquire = to gain or obtain
example: He acquiesced to the terms and thereby acquired a lasting business partnership.

meaning_hi: Acrimonious = कटु/कड़वा (वाद-विवाद); Parsimonious = अत्यंत कंजूस
meaning_en: Acrimonious = angry and bitter in disagreements; Parsimonious = extremely unwilling to spend
example: The acrimonious dispute was partly caused by his parsimonious refusal to share profits.

meaning_hi: Acute = तीव्र/अल्पकालिक; Chronic = दीर्घकालिक/पुराना
meaning_en: Acute = sudden and severe; Chronic = persisting for a long time
example: He suffered an acute attack of fever that developed into a chronic respiratory condition.

meaning_hi: Adapt = अनुकूलित करना; Adopt = अपनाना
meaning_en: Adapt = to adjust to new conditions; Adopt = to take up and make one's own
example: She adapted to the new city quickly after her family adopted a healthier lifestyle.

meaning_hi: Addition = जोड़; Edition = किसी पुस्तक या प्रकाशन का संस्करण
meaning_en: Addition = the process of adding; Edition = a particular version of a published work
example: The new addition to the library is the third edition of that classic novel.

meaning_hi: Adulterate = मिलावट करना; Adultery = विवाहेत्तर संबंध
meaning_en: Adulterate (verb) = to make impure by adding inferior substances; Adultery = voluntary sexual intercourse outside marriage
example: He was arrested for adulterating food products; his personal life was also marred by adultery.

meaning_hi: Adverse = प्रतिकूल (परिस्थिति); Averse = अनिच्छुक (व्यक्ति)
meaning_en: Adverse = unfavourable (conditions); Averse = strongly disinclined (people)
example: She is not averse to change, but adverse weather forced them to cancel the trek.

meaning_hi: Advice = सलाह (संज्ञा); Advise = सलाह देना (क्रिया)
meaning_en: Advice (noun) = guidance given; Advise (verb) = to recommend or counsel
example: My doctor's advice was clear: he advised me to rest completely for two weeks.

meaning_hi: Affect = प्रभाव डालना (क्रिया); Effect = परिणाम (संज्ञा)
meaning_en: Affect (verb) = to influence; Effect (noun) = result or outcome
example: Stress can affect concentration; its effects on long-term health are well documented.

meaning_hi: Affectation = दिखावटी व्यवहार; Affection = सच्चा स्नेह
meaning_en: Affectation = artificial behaviour to impress; Affection = genuine fondness
example: Her affectation of modesty fooled no one; her affection for the children, however, was genuine.

meaning_hi: Affluent = धनी; Effluent = औद्योगिक/सीवेज अपशिष्ट
meaning_en: Affluent = having great wealth; Effluent = liquid waste discharged into the environment
example: The affluent factory owners were fined for releasing untreated effluent into the river.

meaning_hi: Aggravate = स्थिति को बिगाड़ना; Irritate = चिढ़ाना/जलन करना
meaning_en: Aggravate = to make a bad situation worse; Irritate = to annoy or inflame
example: His careless comments irritated the officer and only aggravated an already tense situation.

meaning_hi: Agnostic = अज्ञेयवादी (ईश्वर अज्ञात); Atheist = नास्तिक (ईश्वर नहीं)
meaning_en: Agnostic = believes the existence of God is unknown; Atheist = believes there is no God
example: She described herself as agnostic; her brother was a committed atheist.

meaning_hi: All ready = पूरी तरह तैयार; Already = पहले से (समय)
meaning_en: All ready = completely prepared; Already = before the expected time
example: The team was all ready to leave, but the captain had already sent the itinerary ahead.

meaning_hi: Allay = भय/संदेह शांत करना; Alleviate = दर्द/कठिनाई कम करना
meaning_en: Allay = to reduce fear or doubt; Alleviate = to make suffering less severe
example: The minister's statement allayed public fears; the medicine alleviated the patient's pain.

meaning_hi: Allude = संकेत करना; Elude = बचकर निकल जाना
meaning_en: Allude = to refer indirectly; Elude = to escape or avoid cleverly
example: The speaker alluded to the scandal, but its cause continued to elude the investigators.

meaning_hi: Allusion = अप्रत्यक्ष संकेत; Illusion = भ्रम / झूठा आभास
meaning_en: Allusion = an indirect reference; Illusion = a false impression or belief
example: His speech made an allusion to Shakespeare; the prosperity he described was an illusion.

meaning_hi: Altar = वेदी (पूजा स्थान); Alter = बदलना
meaning_en: Altar (noun) = sacred table in a place of worship; Alter (verb) = to change
example: The priest refused to alter the ceremony that had been performed at the same altar for centuries.

meaning_hi: Alternately = बारी-बारी से; Alternatively = विकल्प के रूप में
meaning_en: Alternately = in turn, one after the other; Alternatively = as another option
example: The fans blew alternately hot and cold; alternatively, the engineer suggested installing a central system.

meaning_hi: Altruistic = परोपकारी; Egoistic = स्वार्थी
meaning_en: Altruistic = showing selfless concern for others; Egoistic = excessively self-centred
example: Her altruistic motives contrasted sharply with the egoistic agenda of her colleagues.

meaning_hi: Ambiguous = अस्पष्ट / दो अर्थ वाला; Ambivalent = मिश्रित भावनाएँ रखने वाला
meaning_en: Ambiguous = having more than one meaning; Ambivalent = having mixed feelings about something
example: The order was ambiguous; even the officer seemed ambivalent about how to carry it out.

meaning_hi: Ameliorate = सुधार लाना; Deteriorate = बिगड़ना
meaning_en: Ameliorate = to make something better; Deteriorate = to become progressively worse
example: Timely intervention ameliorated the conflict before it could deteriorate into violence.

meaning_hi: Amend = संशोधन करना (व्यापक); Emend = पाठ में त्रुटि सुधारना
meaning_en: Amend = to make changes to a law or document broadly; Emend = to correct errors in a text
example: Parliament moved to amend the Act; the editor was asked to emend the typographical errors.

meaning_hi: Amiable = मिलनसार (व्यक्ति); Amicable = सौहार्दपूर्ण (स्थिति/समझौता)
meaning_en: Amiable = friendly in personality (of people); Amicable = done in a friendly spirit (of situations)
example: Her amiable nature helped both parties reach an amicable settlement.

meaning_hi: Among = कई के बीच में (तीन या अधिक); Between = दो के बीच
meaning_en: Among = in the middle of (three or more); Between = in the space separating two things
example: The prize money was divided between two winners, but goodwill was shared among all participants.

meaning_hi: Amoral = नैतिकता की परवाह न करना; Immoral = जानबूझकर अनैतिक
meaning_en: Amoral = not concerned with morality; Immoral = going against accepted moral standards
example: A corporation may be amoral; an official who accepts bribes is actively immoral.

meaning_hi: Analogous = समान कार्य करने वाला (लेकिन उद्गम अलग); Homologous = समान उद्गम और कार्य वाला
meaning_en: Analogous = similar in function but different in origin; Homologous = similar in structure and origin
example: The wings of a bat and an insect are analogous; bat and whale forelimbs are homologous.

meaning_hi: Anarchy = अराजकता (कोई शासन नहीं); Autocracy = एकतंत्र (एक व्यक्ति का शासन)
meaning_en: Anarchy = absence of government or order; Autocracy = system ruled by one person with absolute power
example: After the coup created anarchy, the general imposed autocracy to restore control.

meaning_hi: Anecdote = छोटा रोचक किस्सा; Antidote = विषनाशक/उपाय
meaning_en: Anecdote = a short entertaining account; Antidote = a remedy against poison or a bad situation
example: He opened his speech with an anecdote; education, he argued, is the antidote to ignorance.

meaning_hi: Antecedent = पूर्ववर्ती (grammar/general); Precedent = पूर्व निर्णय (legal)
meaning_en: Antecedent = something that came before; Precedent = an earlier case used as a guide
example: The antecedent of the pronoun must be clear; the judgment set a legal precedent for future cases.

meaning_hi: Apathy = उदासीनता; Empathy = दूसरे की भावना समझना
meaning_en: Apathy = lack of interest or concern; Empathy = ability to understand another's feelings
example: Public apathy towards the crisis was replaced by empathy once the human stories emerged.

meaning_hi: Apposite = सटीक/उचित; Opposite = विपरीत
meaning_en: Apposite = highly appropriate to the situation; Opposite = directly contrary
example: His apposite remark could not have been more opposite to the tone the chairman expected.

meaning_hi: Apprehend = पकड़ना / भय महसूस करना; Comprehend = पूरी तरह समझना
meaning_en: Apprehend = to arrest or to fear; Comprehend = to fully grasp or understand
example: The police moved to apprehend the suspect; only later did the public comprehend the full scale of the fraud.

meaning_hi: Apprise = सूचित करना; Appraise = मूल्यांकन करना
meaning_en: Apprise = to inform someone; Appraise = to assess the value or quality of something
example: Please apprise the manager of the situation so he can appraise the financial risk accurately.

meaning_hi: Arbitrary = मनमाना; Judicious = विवेकपूर्ण
meaning_en: Arbitrary = based on random choice or personal whim; Judicious = showing good judgement
example: His arbitrary decisions were eventually replaced by the judicious policies of his successor.

meaning_hi: Arcane = अत्यंत गूढ़/रहस्यमय; Mundane = साधारण/रोज़मर्रा
meaning_en: Arcane = understood by very few; secret and mysterious; Mundane = routine and ordinary
example: The arcane legal procedure was explained in mundane terms for the general public.

meaning_hi: Arduous = कठिन (शारीरिक); Onerous = बोझिल (जिम्मेदारी में)
meaning_en: Arduous = involving great effort and difficulty; Onerous = involving heavy burden or obligation
example: The arduous trek was made more onerous by the excessive equipment they were required to carry.

meaning_hi: Aristocracy = अभिजात वर्ग का शासन; Democracy = जनता का शासन
meaning_en: Aristocracy = government by the privileged upper class; Democracy = government by elected representatives of the people
example: The revolution swept away the aristocracy and established a democracy in its place.

meaning_hi: Ascent = चढ़ाई/उत्थान; Assent = सहमति
meaning_en: Ascent = the act of climbing or rising; Assent = agreement or approval
example: His rapid ascent in the organisation required the assent of the entire board.

meaning_hi: Assume = बिना प्रमाण के मान लेना; Presume = किसी आधार पर अनुमान लगाना
meaning_en: Assume = to take for granted without evidence; Presume = to suppose something based on reasonable grounds
example: Don't assume she is guilty; the law presumes innocence until proven otherwise.

meaning_hi: Assure = आश्वस्त करना (व्यक्ति); Ensure = सुनिश्चित करना; Insure = बीमा करना
meaning_en: Assure = to promise someone; Ensure = to make certain; Insure = to provide financial insurance
example: I assure you the car is insured; please ensure all documents are in order before the trip.

meaning_hi: Astute = तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि वाला; Shrewd = चालाक/व्यावहारिक
meaning_en: Astute = having sharp insight; Shrewd = having practical cleverness, often for personal gain
example: The astute barrister saw the flaw; the shrewd businessman knew exactly how to use it.

meaning_hi: Aural = कान से संबंधित/श्रवण; Oral = मुँह से/मौखिक
meaning_en: Aural = relating to the ear or hearing; Oral = spoken by mouth
example: The aural comprehension test required listening skills; the oral examination tested speaking ability.

meaning_hi: Autonomy = स्वायत्तता (सीमित स्वशासन); Sovereignty = संप्रभुता (पूर्ण स्वतंत्र शासन)
meaning_en: Autonomy = self-governance within a larger structure; Sovereignty = supreme and independent authority
example: The state demanded greater autonomy; the nation asserted its full sovereignty before the international body.

meaning_hi: Bail = ज़मानत / नाव से पानी उलीचना; Bale = गट्ठर/बंडल
meaning_en: Bail (noun/verb) = security given for release, or to scoop water out; Bale = a bundle of material
example: The judge granted bail; the farmer stacked a bale of hay near the barn.

meaning_hi: Barbaric = अत्यंत क्रूर; Barbarous = असभ्य/अज्ञानी
meaning_en: Barbaric = extremely cruel and brutal; Barbarous = uncivilised or ignorant
example: The barbaric punishment was condemned internationally; barbarous customs had prevailed in that region for centuries.

meaning_hi: Bare = नग्न/खुला; Bear = सहन करना / भालू
meaning_en: Bare (adj/verb) = uncovered or to uncover; Bear (verb/noun) = to endure, or a large animal
example: The bear walked on the bare hillside with a dignity she could barely bear to disturb.

meaning_hi: Bazaar = बाज़ार; Bizarre = अजीब / विचित्र
meaning_en: Bazaar = a market; Bizarre = strange and unusual
example: The bazaar was crowded with bizarre street performers.

meaning_hi: Belligerent = युद्ध में संलग्न / आक्रामक; Bellicose = झगड़ालू स्वभाव वाला
meaning_en: Belligerent = engaged in war or aggressive; Bellicose = having a tendency to argue or fight
example: The bellicose leader turned his nation into a belligerent state within months.

meaning_hi: Benevolent = परोपकारी/दयालु; Malevolent = दुर्भावनापूर्ण
meaning_en: Benevolent = well-meaning and kindly; Malevolent = having or showing ill will
example: The benevolent founder's intentions were distorted by a malevolent board member.

meaning_hi: Berth = शयन स्थान (ट्रेन/जहाज); Birth = जन्म
meaning_en: Berth = a sleeping place in a train or ship; Birth = the act of being born
example: He booked a berth on the overnight train — the city where he had taken birth years ago awaited him.

meaning_hi: Beside = के बगल में; Besides = इसके अतिरिक्त
meaning_en: Beside = next to (position); Besides = in addition to
example: Besides the report, she placed a note beside the manager's keyboard.

meaning_hi: Biannual = वर्ष में दो बार; Biennial = हर दो वर्ष में एक बार
meaning_en: Biannual = occurring twice a year; Biennial = occurring every two years
example: The committee meets biannually in June and December; the international festival is a biennial event.

meaning_hi: Blasé = उदासीन (अत्यधिक अनुभव से); Cynical = संदेहवादी/निंदनीय
meaning_en: Blasé = unimpressed due to over-familiarity; Cynical = distrustful of human sincerity
example: Years of travel had made him blasé; years of politics had made her cynical.

meaning_hi: Borrow = उधार लेना; Lend = उधार देना
meaning_en: Borrow = to take temporarily; Lend = to give temporarily
example: Can you lend me your notes? I need to borrow them for just one hour.

meaning_hi: Brake = ब्रेक (वाहन रोकने का यंत्र); Break = तोड़ना / विराम
meaning_en: Brake (noun/verb) = device to stop a vehicle; Break (verb/noun) = to shatter, or a pause
example: He pressed the brake gently but could not avoid the break in the traffic barrier.

meaning_hi: Buy = खरीदना; By = द्वारा/पास; Bye = अलविदा
meaning_en: Buy (verb) = to purchase; By (prep) = near or through; Bye = farewell
example: Buy the ticket by noon and then wave bye as the train departs.

meaning_hi: Cache = छिपा हुआ भंडार; Cash = नकद धन
meaning_en: Cache = a hidden store of things; Cash = physical money
example: Police discovered a cache of weapons; investigators also traced the flow of illicit cash.

meaning_hi: Callous = निर्दयी; Callus = कड़ी त्वचा
meaning_en: Callous = insensitive and cruel; Callus = hardened skin caused by friction
example: The callous foreman ignored the callus forming on the labourers' hands from overwork.

meaning_hi: Canvas = मोटा कपड़ा / पेंटिंग की सतह; Canvass = राय माँगना / प्रचार करना
meaning_en: Canvas = a heavy cloth used for painting or making tents; Canvass = to seek votes or opinions
example: The artist stretched the canvas while volunteers canvassed the neighbourhood for support.

meaning_hi: Capital = राजधानी / मुख्य अक्षर / पूँजी; Capitol = अमेरिकी संसद भवन
meaning_en: Capital = a city, wealth, or upper-case letter; Capitol = the US Congress building
example: Washington D.C. is the capital of the United States, where the Capitol building is located.

meaning_hi: Capitulate = आत्मसमर्पण करना; Recapitulate = सारांश दोहराना
meaning_en: Capitulate = to give up resistance; Recapitulate = to summarise the main points
example: He refused to capitulate and asked the mediator to recapitulate the terms once more.

meaning_hi: Casual = अनौपचारिक / लापरवाह; Causal = कारणात्मक
meaning_en: Casual = relaxed and informal, or happening by chance; Causal = relating to cause and effect
example: His casual attitude towards safety had a causal link to the accident.

meaning_hi: Casualty = घायल/मृत (आँकड़ा); Fatality = मृत्यु
meaning_en: Casualty = a person killed or injured; Fatality = a death resulting from an accident or disaster
example: The accident caused twenty casualties; three of these were fatalities.

meaning_hi: Celibate = अविवाहित / यौन संबंध से दूर; Chaste = यौन रूप से पवित्र
meaning_en: Celibate = abstaining from marriage and sexual relations; Chaste = refraining from sex outside marriage
example: The monk chose to remain celibate; the couple vowed to remain chaste until marriage.

meaning_hi: Censure = आधिकारिक निंदा करना; Censor = सेंसर करना (सामग्री हटाना)
meaning_en: Censure (verb/noun) = to officially criticise; Censor (verb) = to suppress or remove content
example: The council passed a motion to censure the official who had tried to censor the report.

meaning_hi: Childish = बचकाना (नकारात्मक); Childlike = बच्चे जैसा निर्दोष (सकारात्मक)
meaning_en: Childish = immature and silly; Childlike = innocent and endearing like a child
example: His childish tantrum embarrassed everyone; her childlike curiosity about the world was charming.

meaning_hi: Circumspect = सतर्क/सावधान; Circumscribe = सीमित करना
meaning_en: Circumspect = wary and unwilling to take risks; Circumscribe = to restrict within limits
example: The circumspect minister was careful not to circumscribe the committee's authority.

meaning_hi: Cite = उद्धृत करना; Site = स्थान; Sight = दृश्य / दृष्टि
meaning_en: Cite = to quote as evidence; Site = a location; Sight = the ability to see, or a view
example: The report cited the construction site as an eyesore — a terrible sight for tourists.

meaning_hi: Classic = बेजोड़/श्रेष्ठ उदाहरण; Classical = शास्त्रीय (विशेष काल/शैली)
meaning_en: Classic = of the highest quality or a typical example; Classical = relating to classical antiquity or traditional forms
example: It was a classic error; the piece was performed in the classical Greek tradition.

meaning_hi: Climactic = चरमोत्कर्ष से संबंधित; Climatic = जलवायु से संबंधित
meaning_en: Climactic = relating to the climax of something; Climatic = relating to climate or weather
example: The final confrontation was the climactic scene; the report addressed climatic change in the region.

meaning_hi: Cloth = कपड़ा (संज्ञा); Clothe = कपड़े पहनाना (क्रिया)
meaning_en: Cloth (noun) = woven fabric; Clothe (verb) = to dress or provide clothes
example: She used the finest cloth to clothe the children before the winter set in.

meaning_hi: Coarse = खुरदरा / भद्दा; Course = पाठ्यक्रम / मार्ग
meaning_en: Coarse = rough in texture or manner; Course = route or programme of study
example: His coarse language during the training course annoyed the other participants.

meaning_hi: Cogent = तार्किक रूप से प्रभावशाली; Coherent = सुसंगत/तार्किक क्रम में
meaning_en: Cogent = powerfully convincing; Coherent = logically consistent and clear
example: Her cogent argument was also perfectly coherent from start to finish.

meaning_hi: Coherent = तार्किक रूप से संगत; Cohesive = एकजुट/जुड़ा हुआ
meaning_en: Coherent = logically consistent and clear; Cohesive = forming a united whole
example: His argument was coherent but the team lacked a cohesive strategy.

meaning_hi: Collaborate = मिलकर काम करना; Corroborate = साक्ष्य से पुष्टि करना
meaning_en: Collaborate = to work jointly; Corroborate = to confirm with evidence
example: The two scientists collaborated on the study; their findings corroborated earlier research.

meaning_hi: Colonel = कर्नल (सैन्य अधिकारी); Kernel = बीज का दाना / मूल भाग
meaning_en: Colonel = a senior army officer; Kernel = central part of a nut or seed; essence
example: The colonel identified the kernel of truth hidden within the intelligence report.

meaning_hi: Complaisant = खुशी से दूसरों की इच्छा पूरी करना; Complacent = आत्मसंतुष्ट/लापरवाह
meaning_en: Complaisant = eager to please; Complacent = smugly satisfied and unaware of risks
example: A complaisant aide agreed to everything; the complacent management ignored the growing threat.

meaning_hi: Complement = पूरक बनाना (क्रिया/संज्ञा); Compliment = प्रशंसा
meaning_en: Complement = something that completes or enhances; Compliment = an expression of praise
example: She received a compliment on how her accessories complemented her outfit perfectly.

meaning_hi: Compose = बनाना / रचना करना; Comprise = शामिल होना
meaning_en: Compose = to make up or create; Comprise = to consist of or include
example: The committee comprises five members; their individual talents compose a strong team.

meaning_hi: Confident = आत्मविश्वासी; Confidant = विश्वासपात्र मित्र
meaning_en: Confident (adj) = feeling self-assurance; Confidant (noun) = a trusted friend
example: She was confident in her decisions and chose only one confidant to share her concerns.

meaning_hi: Confirm = पुष्टि करना; Conform = अनुरूप होना / नियम का पालन करना
meaning_en: Confirm = to establish the truth of; Conform = to comply with rules or standards
example: Please confirm your attendance; all guests are expected to conform to the dress code.

meaning_hi: Congenial = अनुकूल/मिलनसार; Congenital = जन्मजात
meaning_en: Congenial = pleasant and suited to one's taste; Congenital = existing from birth
example: The congenial atmosphere helped the patient who had been living with a congenital heart condition.

meaning_hi: Connotation = अप्रत्यक्ष/सांकेतिक अर्थ; Denotation = शाब्दिक/प्रत्यक्ष अर्थ
meaning_en: Connotation = implied or associated meaning; Denotation = literal or primary meaning
example: The denotation of 'snake' is a reptile; its connotation is treachery.

meaning_hi: Connote = अप्रत्यक्ष अर्थ देना; Denote = प्रत्यक्ष अर्थ देना
meaning_en: Connote = to imply or suggest in addition to the literal meaning; Denote = to indicate directly
example: The word 'home' denotes a place to live; it connotes warmth, safety and belonging.

meaning_hi: Conscience = अंतरात्मा / अंतःकरण; Conscious = जागरूक / चेतन
meaning_en: Conscience = the inner sense of right and wrong; Conscious = aware and alert
example: She was conscious of her mistake, and her conscience compelled her to apologise.

meaning_hi: Contemptible = घृणास्पद (दूसरे के लिए); Contemptuous = घृणापूर्ण (स्वयं का रवैया)
meaning_en: Contemptible = deserving contempt; Contemptuous = feeling or showing contempt
example: His contemptible behaviour made him the subject of contemptuous remarks from colleagues.

meaning_hi: Continual = बार-बार (छोटे-छोटे विराम के साथ); Continuous = बिना रुके जारी
meaning_en: Continual = frequently recurring with short breaks; Continuous = without any interruption
example: Continual interruptions made it hard to follow the continuous broadcast of the ceremony.

meaning_hi: Convoluted = अत्यधिक जटिल; Involved = शामिल/पेचीदा
meaning_en: Convoluted = extremely complex and difficult to follow; Involved = complicated or engaged in
example: The convoluted procedure involved three departments and seventeen separate approval stages.

meaning_hi: Corporal = शारीरिक दंड संबंधी; Corporeal = भौतिक/शरीर से संबंधित
meaning_en: Corporal = relating to the body, especially punishment; Corporeal = having a physical body
example: Corporal punishment was banned; the debate was about corporeal versus spiritual existence.

meaning_hi: Council = परिषद (समूह); Counsel = सलाह / वकील
meaning_en: Council (noun) = a governing or advisory body; Counsel (noun/verb) = legal advice, or to advise
example: The council sought legal counsel before passing the contentious amendment.

meaning_hi: Credible = विश्वसनीय; Credulous = भोला (आसानी से विश्वास करने वाला)
meaning_en: Credible = capable of being believed; Credulous = too ready to believe things
example: A credulous person might accept any story, even one that lacks credible evidence.

meaning_hi: Criterion = मानदंड (एकवचन); Criteria = मानदंड (बहुवचन)
meaning_en: Criterion = a single standard for judgement; Criteria = the plural form
example: The main criterion was experience; the selection criteria included qualifications and performance.

meaning_hi: Cynical = संदेहवादी (मानव प्रकृति पर); Sceptical = संशयवादी (किसी बात पर)
meaning_en: Cynical = distrustful of human sincerity; Sceptical = having doubts about something specific
example: He was cynical about politicians in general; she was sceptical about this particular claim.

meaning_hi: Debilitate = कमज़ोर बनाना; Devitalise = जीवन-शक्ति नष्ट करना
meaning_en: Debilitate = to make weak; Devitalise = to deprive of vitality and energy
example: The prolonged illness debilitated him physically; the isolation devitalised his spirit.

meaning_hi: Decimate = भारी नुकसान पहुँचाना; Devastate = पूरी तरह तबाह करना
meaning_en: Decimate = to kill or destroy a large proportion of; Devastate = to cause severe destruction
example: The epidemic decimated the cattle population; the flood devastated entire villages.

meaning_hi: Deduce = तर्क से निष्कर्ष निकालना; Deduct = घटाना/काटना
meaning_en: Deduce = to arrive at a conclusion through reasoning; Deduct = to subtract an amount
example: The detective deduced the identity of the culprit; the accountant deducted tax from the salary.

meaning_hi: Defamation = मानहानि (कानूनी); Denigration = छोटा दिखाना/बदनाम करना
meaning_en: Defamation = the legal act of damaging reputation; Denigration = unfair belittling
example: The article amounted to defamation; its denigration of the scientist's career was unwarranted.

meaning_hi: Deference = आदरपूर्ण समर्पण; Difference = अंतर
meaning_en: Deference = respectful submission to another's wishes; Difference = a point of dissimilarity
example: In deference to the elder's wishes, the difference of opinion was set aside.

meaning_hi: Deficient = अपर्याप्त/कमज़ोर; Deficit = कमी/घाटा
meaning_en: Deficient (adj) = not having enough; Deficit (noun) = a shortfall in money or resources
example: The diet was deficient in iron; the government announced a fiscal deficit of two trillion rupees.

meaning_hi: Delusion = मानसिक भ्रम (विश्वास); Illusion = इंद्रियजनित भ्रम (दृश्य/धारणा)
meaning_en: Delusion = a false belief held despite evidence; Illusion = a false perception of reality
example: His belief that he was persecuted was a delusion; the magician's trick was a mere illusion.

meaning_hi: Deny = अस्वीकार करना; Refute = तर्क/साक्ष्य से खंडन करना
meaning_en: Deny = to declare that something is not true; Refute = to prove something is wrong with evidence
example: He denied the allegations; the defence counsel refuted them with irrefutable evidence.

meaning_hi: Dependant = आश्रित व्यक्ति (संज्ञा); Dependent = निर्भर (विशेषण)
meaning_en: Dependant = a person who relies on another (noun); Dependent = relying on something (adjective)
example: He has two dependants; his income is wholly dependent on freelance work.

meaning_hi: Deprecate = आलोचना करना/अस्वीकार करना; Depreciate = मूल्य घटाना
meaning_en: Deprecate = to express disapproval; Depreciate = to decrease in value
example: The committee deprecated the wasteful policy, noting that the assets had also depreciated sharply.

meaning_hi: Desert = रेगिस्तान / त्यागना; Dessert = मिठाई (भोजन के बाद)
meaning_en: Desert (noun) = dry barren land; (verb) = to abandon; Dessert = sweet course after a meal
example: The soldier who deserted his post in the desert was eventually caught eating dessert at a café.

meaning_hi: Desolate = उजाड़/निर्जन; Dissolute = अनैतिक/विलासी
meaning_en: Desolate = empty, bleak; Dissolute = lacking moral restraint
example: The abandoned town looked desolate; its former owner had led a dissolute life.

meaning_hi: Device = उपकरण (संज्ञा); Devise = योजना बनाना (क्रिया)
meaning_en: Device (noun) = a tool or machine; Devise (verb) = to plan or invent
example: The engineer devised a compact device to purify water in remote areas.

meaning_hi: Devolve = अधिकार निचले स्तर पर सौंपना; Evolve = धीरे-धीरे विकसित होना
meaning_en: Devolve = to transfer powers to a lower level; Evolve = to develop gradually
example: Parliament voted to devolve power to state governments; governance structures evolve over time.

meaning_hi: Diaphanous = पारदर्शी/बहुत पतला; Opaque = अपारदर्शी
meaning_en: Diaphanous = light and translucent; Opaque = not allowing light to pass through
example: The diaphanous curtains were replaced with opaque blinds to block the sunlight.

meaning_hi: Diary = दैनिक पत्रिका / रोज़नामचा; Dairy = डेयरी / दूध उत्पाद
meaning_en: Diary = a daily personal journal; Dairy = a place where milk is processed, or milk products
example: She noted in her diary that the dairy near her house had shut down.

meaning_hi: Didactic = उपदेशात्मक (शिक्षा देने वाला); Pedantic = ज्ञान का बेवजह प्रदर्शन
meaning_en: Didactic = intended to teach a moral lesson; Pedantic = overly concerned with minor details
example: His didactic approach was appreciated; her pedantic corrections irritated the whole class.

meaning_hi: Diffident = संकोची/झिझकने वाला; Indifferent = उदासीन/परवाह न करने वाला
meaning_en: Diffident = modest or shy due to lack of confidence; Indifferent = having no interest or concern
example: The diffident student barely spoke in class; the indifferent official showed no concern for the complaint.

meaning_hi: Discreet = सावधान/विवेकी (जानकारी में); Discrete = अलग-अलग/स्वतंत्र
meaning_en: Discreet = careful not to attract attention; Discrete = individually separate and distinct
example: The mediator was discreet about the talks; the report identified three discrete categories of fraud.

meaning_hi: Disease = शरीर में रोग; Illness = अस्वस्थता की भावना; Sickness = उल्टी/जी मिचलाना
meaning_en: Disease = a clinical condition; Illness = subjective feeling of being unwell; Sickness = nausea
example: He was diagnosed with a disease; his illness kept him home; motion sickness plagued him on every journey.

meaning_hi: Disinterested = निष्पक्ष (व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ नहीं); Uninterested = रुचिहीन
meaning_en: Disinterested = impartial, having no personal stake; Uninterested = having no interest or curiosity
example: A judge must be disinterested; an uninterested juror, however, risks missing key facts.

meaning_hi: Dominant = प्रभावशाली; Predominant = सर्वाधिक प्रमुख/मुख्य
meaning_en: Dominant = most important or powerful; Predominant = present as the strongest or main element
example: English is a dominant language globally; Hindi is the predominant language in northern India.

meaning_hi: Draft = मसौदा / प्रारूप; Draught = हवा का झोंका / एक घूँट (पेय)
meaning_en: Draft = a rough version of a document; Draught = a current of cold air, or a drink
example: He sat in a cold draught by the window while finalising the draft of the report.

meaning_hi: Dual = दोहरा / दोहरे उद्देश्य वाला; Duel = द्वंद्वयुद्ध
meaning_en: Dual = having two parts or purposes; Duel = a formal fight between two people
example: The dual-use technology had a dangerous side; the inventors challenged each other to a duel of ideas.

meaning_hi: Ebullient = उत्साहपूर्ण (बुदबुदाहट जैसा); Exuberant = अत्यधिक जोशीला
meaning_en: Ebullient = cheerful and full of energy; Exuberant = filled with lively energy and enthusiasm
example: The ebullient child became exuberant when she heard they were going to the fair.

meaning_hi: Eccentric = सनकी (व्यक्ति); Erratic = अनिश्चित/अनियमित (व्यवहार/घटना)
meaning_en: Eccentric = unconventional and slightly strange; Erratic = not even or regular
example: The eccentric professor was brilliant; his attendance was erratic throughout the semester.

meaning_hi: Economic = आर्थिक (अर्थव्यवस्था से संबंधित); Economical = मितव्ययी (कम खर्च करने वाला)
meaning_en: Economic = relating to the economy; Economical = using money or resources carefully
example: The new economic policy favoured an economical use of natural resources.

meaning_hi: Effective = प्रभावशाली; Effectual = वांछित परिणाम देने वाला; Efficient = कम साधन में अधिक काम
meaning_en: Effective = producing results; Effectual = capable of producing the intended effect; Efficient = using minimum resources
example: The drug was effective; the remedy was effectual; the new process was efficient and cost-saving.

meaning_hi: Elicit = प्रकट करना/उद्बुद्ध करना; Illicit = अवैध
meaning_en: Elicit (verb) = to draw out a response; Illicit (adj) = forbidden by law
example: The interrogation was designed to elicit a confession about the illicit trade.

meaning_hi: Eligible = पात्र/योग्य; Illegible = अपठनीय
meaning_en: Eligible = qualified or suitable; Illegible = impossible to read
example: He was eligible for the scholarship, but his illegible handwriting on the form caused delays.

meaning_hi: Elusive = पकड़ में न आने वाला / मायावी; Illusive = भ्रामक / झूठे आभास वाला
meaning_en: Elusive = difficult to find, catch, or achieve; Illusive = based on or producing illusion
example: The spy remained elusive; his promises of peace turned out to be illusive.

meaning_hi: Eminent = प्रसिद्ध; Imminent = निकट आने वाला; Immanent = अंतर्निहित
meaning_en: Eminent = distinguished; Imminent = about to happen very soon; Immanent = inherent within
example: The eminent philosopher believed God to be immanent in nature, warning that a storm was imminent.

meaning_hi: Empathetic = दूसरे की भावना में डूब जाना; Sympathetic = सहानुभूति रखना
meaning_en: Empathetic = understanding another's feelings from inside; Sympathetic = feeling pity from outside
example: A counsellor must be empathetic, not merely sympathetic, to truly help clients.

meaning_hi: Emulate = मुकाबला करते हुए नकल; Imitate = नकल करना
meaning_en: Emulate = to try to equal or surpass; Imitate = to copy someone's actions
example: Young leaders emulate successful predecessors; children often imitate their parents.

meaning_hi: Endemic = स्थानिक रोग; Epidemic = क्षेत्रीय महामारी; Pandemic = वैश्विक महामारी
meaning_en: Endemic = consistently found in a particular area; Epidemic = a widespread disease in a region; Pandemic = a disease spreading worldwide
example: Malaria is endemic to parts of Africa; cholera caused an epidemic; COVID-19 became a pandemic.

meaning_hi: Enormity = भीषणता/दुष्टता की गंभीरता; Enormousness = विशाल आकार
meaning_en: Enormity = the extreme seriousness of a wrong; Enormousness = great size
example: The enormity of the crime shocked the nation; the enormousness of the task required all available resources.

meaning_hi: Envelop = ढकना / घेरना (क्रिया); Envelope = लिफ़ाफ़ा (संज्ञा)
meaning_en: Envelop = to wrap or surround completely (verb); Envelope = a paper container for a letter (noun)
example: Thick fog began to envelop the city; she sealed the envelope and posted the letter.

meaning_hi: Envious = ईर्ष्यालु (दूसरे की चीज़ चाहना); Jealous = ईर्ष्यालु (अपनी चीज़ खोने का डर)
meaning_en: Envious = wanting what another has; Jealous = fearful of losing what one already possesses
example: She was envious of his promotion; he became jealous when others praised her work.

meaning_hi: Envy = ईर्ष्या (भावना); Covet = लालसा रखना (इच्छा/क्रिया)
meaning_en: Envy = a feeling of wanting what another has; Covet = to desire something belonging to another
example: She felt envy at her colleague's promotion; he began to covet her position.

meaning_hi: Ephemeral = क्षणिक/अल्पकालिक; Perennial = दीर्घकालिक/बारहमासी
meaning_en: Ephemeral = lasting for a very short time; Perennial = lasting for a long or indefinite time
example: Fame can be ephemeral; the pursuit of knowledge is perennial.

meaning_hi: Epitaph = समाधि-लेख; Epithet = विशेषण / उपाधि
meaning_en: Epitaph = an inscription on a tombstone; Epithet = a word or phrase describing a quality of a person
example: His epitaph read 'Beloved Teacher'; the epithet 'Iron Lady' defined his predecessor's legacy.

meaning_hi: Equitable = न्यायसंगत (आवश्यकता के अनुसार); Equal = बराबर (समान मात्रा)
meaning_en: Equitable = fair according to need; Equal = the same for all
example: Justice requires an equitable distribution of resources, not merely an equal one.

meaning_hi: Equivocal = अस्पष्ट/संदिग्ध; Unequivocal = पूरी तरह स्पष्ट
meaning_en: Equivocal = open to more than one interpretation; Unequivocal = leaving no doubt
example: His equivocal answer was replaced with an unequivocal statement the next day.

meaning_hi: Erudite = अत्यंत विद्वान; Literate = पढ़ा-लिखा
meaning_en: Erudite = having great knowledge acquired from reading; Literate = able to read and write
example: Being literate is necessary; being erudite requires years of deep study.

meaning_hi: Euphemism = मृदु शब्द (कठोर बात को); Dysphemism = कठोर शब्द (सामान्य बात के लिए)
meaning_en: Euphemism = mild expression for unpleasant reality; Dysphemism = harsh expression for something ordinary
example: 'Passed away' is a euphemism for death; 'croaked' is a dysphemism.

meaning_hi: Exhaustive = व्यापक / सम्पूर्ण; Exhausted = थका हुआ / समाप्त
meaning_en: Exhaustive = thorough and complete; Exhausted = completely tired or used up
example: The researchers compiled an exhaustive report, leaving themselves exhausted.

meaning_hi: Expedient = व्यावहारिक / तात्कालिक सुविधा के लिए; Expeditious = शीघ्र / तेज़
meaning_en: Expedient = convenient and practical though possibly improper; Expeditious = quick and efficient
example: It was expedient to take the shortcut, and the team completed it in an expeditious manner.

meaning_hi: Explicit = स्पष्ट/प्रत्यक्ष; Implicit = अप्रत्यक्ष/निहित
meaning_en: Explicit = stated clearly and in detail; Implicit = suggested but not directly stated
example: The contract contained an explicit penalty clause and an implicit understanding of confidentiality.

meaning_hi: Facetious = हँसी में गलत समय पर बोलना; Fatuous = मूर्खतापूर्ण/निरर्थक
meaning_en: Facetious = treating serious matters flippantly; Fatuous = silly and pointless
example: His facetious remark during the meeting was dismissed as merely fatuous.

meaning_hi: Faint = बेहोश होना / हल्का; Feint = दिखावटी हमला / धोखे की चाल
meaning_en: Faint = to lose consciousness briefly, or lacking strength; Feint = a mock attack to distract an opponent
example: She felt faint in the heat; the boxer used a feint to confuse his opponent.

meaning_hi: Fallacious = भ्रामक/गलत तर्क पर आधारित; Fallible = गलती करने योग्य
meaning_en: Fallacious = based on a mistaken belief; Fallible = capable of making mistakes
example: Even fallible humans can identify fallacious reasoning with careful thought.

meaning_hi: Farther = भौतिक दूरी में अधिक; Further = अतिरिक्त / आगे (लाक्षणिक अर्थ)
meaning_en: Farther = greater physical distance; Further = additional or to a greater extent
example: Jaipur is farther from Delhi than Agra; the matter requires further investigation.

meaning_hi: Fastidious = अत्यंत सावधानी से काम करने वाला; Finicky = अत्यधिक चुनिंदा
meaning_en: Fastidious = very attentive to accuracy and detail; Finicky = excessively particular about things
example: The fastidious editor corrected every comma; the finicky author objected to every suggestion.

meaning_hi: Fatal = जानलेवा; Fateful = भाग्यनिर्णायक
meaning_en: Fatal = causing death; Fateful = having important consequences
example: The injury proved fatal; it was a fateful decision that changed the company's direction forever.

meaning_hi: Feasible = व्यावहारिक रूप से संभव; Possible = सैद्धांतिक रूप से संभव
meaning_en: Feasible = capable of being done in practice; Possible = capable of happening in theory
example: It is possible to build a colony on Mars; whether it is feasible remains to be determined.

meaning_hi: Ferment = किण्वन / अशांति; Foment = भड़काना / उकसाना
meaning_en: Ferment = to undergo fermentation, or a state of agitation; Foment = to instigate or stir up trouble
example: Social ferment was rising, fuelled by agitators who sought to foment unrest.

meaning_hi: Fervent = उत्कट/जोशीला; Fervid = अत्यधिक उत्साहपूर्ण (कभी-कभी अत्यधिक)
meaning_en: Fervent = very enthusiastic and sincere; Fervid = intensely enthusiastic (sometimes excessively)
example: Her fervent belief in justice was admirable; his fervid speeches were too intense for many.

meaning_hi: Fewer = कम (गिनने योग्य); Less = कम (अगणनीय)
meaning_en: Fewer = smaller number of countable things; Less = smaller amount of uncountable things
example: Fewer students enrolled this year; consequently, the institute had less pressure on resources.

meaning_hi: Figurative = लाक्षणिक अर्थ; Literal = शाब्दिक/वास्तविक अर्थ
meaning_en: Figurative = using figures of speech; Literal = taking words in their exact sense
example: He was literally exhausted and figuratively drowning in paperwork.

meaning_hi: Flagrant = स्पष्ट रूप से अपमानजनक; Blatant = अत्यंत स्पष्ट/घोर
meaning_en: Flagrant = conspicuously or obviously offensive; Blatant = done openly and unashamedly
example: The flagrant disregard for rules and the blatant lies caused public outrage.

meaning_hi: Flair = प्राकृतिक प्रतिभा / शैली; Flare = भड़कना / रोशनी का संकेत
meaning_en: Flair = a natural talent or stylish quality; Flare = to burn with a sudden flame, or a signal light
example: She had a flair for design; the emergency team fired a flare to signal for help.

meaning_hi: Flamboyant = चमकदार/आकर्षक; Ostentatious = दिखावे के लिए धन-प्रदर्शन
meaning_en: Flamboyant = tending to attract attention through elaborate style; Ostentatious = designed to impress
example: His flamboyant personality was charming; her ostentatious jewellery attracted only ridicule.

meaning_hi: Flatter = चापलूसी करना (स्वार्थ); Compliment = सच्ची प्रशंसा करना
meaning_en: Flatter = to praise excessively and insincerely; Compliment = to express genuine admiration
example: He flattered the manager to gain a promotion; she complimented the artist on his genuine talent.

meaning_hi: Flaunt = दिखावा करना; Flout = नियमों की अवहेलना करना
meaning_en: Flaunt = to display ostentatiously; Flout = to openly disregard a rule
example: He flaunted his wealth while flouting every financial regulation in the book.

meaning_hi: Florid = अत्यधिक अलंकृत (शैली); Fluent = धाराप्रवाह
meaning_en: Florid = using very elaborate language; Fluent = able to speak or write smoothly
example: He was fluent in French but his florid style made even simple letters unreadable.

meaning_hi: Formally = औपचारिक रूप से; Formerly = पहले / पूर्व में
meaning_en: Formally = in an official or ceremonial manner; Formerly = at an earlier time
example: The treaty was formally signed today; the site was formerly a battlefield.

meaning_hi: Former = पहला (दो में से); Latter = दूसरा (दो में से)
meaning_en: Former = the first of two things mentioned; Latter = the second of two mentioned
example: Of honesty and cleverness, the former is more enduring; the latter, without ethics, is dangerous.

meaning_hi: Fort = किला; Forte = विशेष कौशल / ताकत
meaning_en: Fort = a military stronghold; Forte = a person's strong point or special skill
example: The soldiers held the fort; mathematics was never her forte.

meaning_hi: Fortuitous = संयोगवश घटित; Fortunate = भाग्यशाली
meaning_en: Fortuitous = happening by chance, not necessarily good; Fortunate = lucky and having good outcomes
example: Their meeting was fortuitous; it proved fortunate that they met at all.

meaning_hi: Founder = डूबना/असफल हो जाना; Flounder = संघर्ष करना
meaning_en: Founder = to sink or fail completely; Flounder = to struggle awkwardly
example: The startup foundered after losing its chief investor; the new recruit floundered during the first month.

meaning_hi: Fragile = आसानी से टूटने वाला (वस्तु); Frail = शारीरिक रूप से कमज़ोर
meaning_en: Fragile = easily broken; Frail = physically weak
example: The ancient vase was fragile; the elderly patient was too frail to walk unaided.

meaning_hi: Frugal = मितव्ययी / किफ़ायती; Austere = सादगीपूर्ण / कठोर
meaning_en: Frugal = careful with money and resources; Austere = severely simple, or morally strict
example: Her frugal habits ensured savings; the monk's austere lifestyle had no comforts.

meaning_hi: Gait = चलने की चाल; Gate = द्वार/फाटक
meaning_en: Gait = a manner of walking; Gate = a hinged barrier at an entrance
example: He walked through the iron gate with the confident gait of someone who owned the place.

meaning_hi: Gamble = जुआ खेलना; Gambol = उछलना-कूदना
meaning_en: Gamble = to bet money on an uncertain outcome; Gambol = to skip about playfully
example: Children gambolled in the meadow while their parents gambled away the evening at cards.

meaning_hi: Garrulous = बकबक करने वाला; Loquacious = बातूनी (लेकिन आनंददायक)
meaning_en: Garrulous = excessively talkative, especially about trivial things; Loquacious = talkative in an engaging way
example: The garrulous neighbour exhausted everyone; the loquacious professor entertained his class.

meaning_hi: Genial = मिलनसार/सौम्य; Jovial = हँसमुख/मज़ेदार
meaning_en: Genial = friendly and cheerful; Jovial = cheerful and joyful, especially in company
example: The genial professor was well-liked; the jovial host kept the party lively all evening.

meaning_hi: Germane = सीधे विषय से संबंधित; Relevant = प्रासंगिक
meaning_en: Germane = directly pertinent; Relevant = closely connected to the matter
example: Only germane evidence was admitted; relevant background was summarised separately.

meaning_hi: Gorilla = गोरिल्ला (वानर); Guerrilla = छापामार लड़ाका
meaning_en: Gorilla = a large primate; Guerrilla = a fighter in an irregular military force
example: The documentary about gorillas was interrupted by news of guerrilla attacks.

meaning_hi: Gracious = कृपालु/शालीन; Grateful = आभारी
meaning_en: Gracious = courteous and kind in manner; Grateful = feeling or showing thankfulness
example: She was gracious in defeat and grateful to those who had supported her throughout.

meaning_hi: Grandiloquent = अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण/आडंबरपूर्ण; Magniloquent = अत्यधिक भव्य भाषा
meaning_en: Grandiloquent = pompous or inflated in style; Magniloquent = using high-flown language
example: His grandiloquent introduction was followed by a magniloquent speech that said very little.

meaning_hi: Gratuitous = बेवजह/अनुचित; Voluntary = स्वैच्छिक/इच्छुक
meaning_en: Gratuitous = uncalled for, unwarranted; Voluntary = done freely without compulsion
example: The gratuitous violence in the film was criticised; voluntary contributions funded the relief effort.

meaning_hi: Grisly = भयानक/रोंगटे खड़े करने वाला; Grizzly = भूरा भालू (उत्तर अमेरिकी)
meaning_en: Grisly = causing horror or disgust; Grizzly = a large species of North American bear
example: The grisly scene in the forest turned out to be a grizzly bear's encounter with a deer.

meaning_hi: Hanged = फाँसी दी गई (व्यक्ति को); Hung = लटकाया गया (वस्तु को)
meaning_en: Hanged = executed by hanging (only for people); Hung = suspended from above (for objects)
example: The convicted criminal was hanged at dawn; the portraits were hung in the courtroom.

meaning_hi: Hapless = दुर्भाग्यशाली; Helpless = असहाय
meaning_en: Hapless = unlucky and deserving of pity; Helpless = unable to defend oneself
example: The hapless victim was left helpless in the middle of an unfamiliar city.

meaning_hi: Haughty = घमंडी (दिखावट में); Arrogant = अहंकारी (व्यवहार में)
meaning_en: Haughty = blatantly proud and disdainful; Arrogant = offensively self-important
example: Her haughty manner alienated colleagues; his arrogant dismissal of others' ideas destroyed the team.

meaning_hi: Hegemony = प्रभुत्व/वर्चस्व; Hierarchy = पदानुक्रम
meaning_en: Hegemony = dominance of one group over others; Hierarchy = system in which things are ranked
example: The nation sought hegemony in the region; its strict internal hierarchy made reform difficult.

meaning_hi: Historic = ऐतिहासिक महत्व का; Historical = इतिहास से संबंधित
meaning_en: Historic = famous or important in history; Historical = relating to past events
example: The signing of the treaty was a historic event; historians gathered historical documents to record it.

meaning_hi: Hoard = भंडार जमा करना; Horde = विशाल भीड़
meaning_en: Hoard (verb/noun) = to accumulate secretly; Horde = a large disorganised crowd
example: A horde of shoppers descended on the store to grab the hidden hoard of discounted goods.

meaning_hi: Homogeneous = एकसमान/एकरूप; Heterogeneous = विविध/अलग-अलग
meaning_en: Homogeneous = of the same kind throughout; Heterogeneous = of diverse elements
example: A homogeneous mixture has uniform composition; a heterogeneous society draws strength from diversity.

meaning_hi: Human = मानव; Humane = दयालु/मानवीय
meaning_en: Human = a person or relating to people; Humane = showing compassion and kindness
example: Every human being deserves humane treatment regardless of their circumstances.

meaning_hi: Humility = नम्रता / विनम्रता; Humiliation = अपमान / लज्जा
meaning_en: Humility = a modest sense of one's own importance; Humiliation = the feeling of shame and embarrassment
example: He accepted criticism with humility, never allowing defeat to become humiliation.

meaning_hi: Hyper = अति / अधिक (उपसर्ग); Hypo = न्यून / कम (उपसर्ग)
meaning_en: Hyper = a prefix meaning over or above normal; Hypo = a prefix meaning under or below normal
example: Hypertension means high blood pressure; hypotension means dangerously low blood pressure.

meaning_hi: Idle = निष्क्रिय/बेकार; Indolent = सुस्त (स्वभाव से आलसी)
meaning_en: Idle = not working; Indolent = habitually lazy by nature
example: He was idle during the strike; the indolent student rarely completed any assignment.

meaning_hi: Immunity = प्रतिरोधक क्षमता/कानूनी छूट; Impunity = दंड से मुक्ति
meaning_en: Immunity = protection from disease or legal action; Impunity = freedom from punishment
example: Diplomatic immunity protected the envoy; the corrupt officers acted with complete impunity.

meaning_hi: Impel = आंतरिक प्रेरणा से प्रेरित करना; Compel = बाहरी दबाव से मजबूर करना
meaning_en: Impel = to drive or urge from within; Compel = to force by external pressure
example: Conscience impelled her to confess; circumstances compelled him to resign.

meaning_hi: Impetuous = आवेगशील/तीव्र; Impulsive = आवेग में काम करने वाला
meaning_en: Impetuous = acting quickly with little thought; Impulsive = acting on sudden urge
example: The impetuous general launched an impulsive attack that had not been planned.

meaning_hi: Imply = संकेत देना (बोलने वाला); Infer = निष्कर्ष निकालना (सुनने वाला)
meaning_en: Imply = to suggest without stating directly (speaker); Infer = to deduce from evidence (listener)
example: Her silence implied disapproval; he inferred from her expression that she disagreed.

meaning_hi: Incredulous = अविश्वासी / संशयपूर्ण; Incredible = अविश्वसनीय / अद्भुत
meaning_en: Incredulous = unwilling to believe; Incredible = impossible to believe; extraordinary
example: She was incredulous when she heard the incredible story of survival.

meaning_hi: Indict = अभियोग लगाना (कानूनी); Indite = लिखना/रचना करना (पुराना)
meaning_en: Indict = to formally charge with a crime; Indite (archaic) = to write or compose
example: The jury moved to indict the accused; the scribe was asked to indite the official record.

meaning_hi: Indifferent = उदासीन (देखभाल नहीं); Apathetic = उदासीन (भावनाशून्य)
meaning_en: Indifferent = having no particular interest; Apathetic = showing no feeling or energy
example: He was indifferent to the outcome; the rest of the committee appeared completely apathetic.

meaning_hi: Indigent = अत्यंत गरीब; Indignant = न्याय न मिलने पर क्रोधित
meaning_en: Indigent = extremely poor; Indignant = angry at unfair treatment
example: The lawyer took the case pro bono for the indigent client; the wrongly accused man was indignant.

meaning_hi: Infectious = संक्रामक (हवा/पानी से); Contagious = संपर्क से फैलने वाला
meaning_en: Infectious = spread through air or water; Contagious = spread by direct contact
example: Tuberculosis is infectious; ringworm is contagious and spreads by touch.

meaning_hi: Ingenious = चतुर/कुशल; Ingenuous = भोला/निष्कपट
meaning_en: Ingenious = clever and inventive; Ingenuous = innocent, frank and unsuspecting
example: The ingenious trap was set for the most ingenuous member of the group.

meaning_hi: Inhibit = रोकना (अंदर से/मनोवैज्ञानिक); Prohibit = मना करना (बाहर से/कानूनी)
meaning_en: Inhibit = to restrain internally; Prohibit = to formally forbid by authority
example: Anxiety inhibited his ability to speak freely; the law prohibits the sale of alcohol to minors.

meaning_hi: Inimical = शत्रुतापूर्ण/हानिकारक; Inimitable = अनुकरणीय (नकल न की जा सके)
meaning_en: Inimical = hostile or harmful; Inimitable = impossible to imitate
example: His inimitable style was inimical to the conventional norms of the publishing industry.

meaning_hi: Innate = जन्मजात (व्यक्ति में); Inherent = किसी वस्तु में अंतर्निहित
meaning_en: Innate = inborn in a person; Inherent = forming an inseparable part of something
example: Curiosity may be innate in humans; the risk is inherent in the design of the system.

meaning_hi: Innovation = नवाचार (नई विधि); Invention = आविष्कार (नई वस्तु/सिद्धांत)
meaning_en: Innovation = a new method or improvement; Invention = creating something entirely new
example: The smartphone was an invention; making it affordable was an innovation.

meaning_hi: Insidious = चालाकी से हानिकारक; Invidious = ईर्ष्या उत्पन्न करने वाला
meaning_en: Insidious = proceeding in a gradual harmful way; Invidious = likely to arouse resentment
example: The insidious rumour spread quietly; the invidious comparison between the two officers caused tension.

meaning_hi: Insight = अंतर्दृष्टि (पहले से समझ); Hindsight = पीछे मुड़कर समझना
meaning_en: Insight = understanding something deeply in advance; Hindsight = understanding in retrospect
example: In hindsight, the warning signs were obvious; at the time, nobody had the insight to see them.

meaning_hi: Insolent = ढीठ / अपमानजनक; Insolvent = दिवालिया
meaning_en: Insolent = rude and disrespectful; Insolvent = unable to pay debts
example: The insolent clerk was dismissed; the once-rich trader was now insolvent.

meaning_hi: Integral = अभिन्न/आवश्यक अंग; Intrinsic = आंतरिक/स्वाभाविक मूल्य
meaning_en: Integral = essential as part of a whole; Intrinsic = belonging naturally to something
example: Honesty is integral to good governance; it has intrinsic value beyond its practical benefits.

meaning_hi: Intermittent = नियमित अंतराल पर रुकने वाला; Sporadic = अनियमित/छिटपुट
meaning_en: Intermittent = stopping and starting at regular intervals; Sporadic = occurring at irregular intervals
example: The rain was intermittent throughout the day; sporadic violence erupted in the border region.

meaning_hi: Intractable = हठी/जिद्दी (समस्या); Recalcitrant = अवज्ञाकारी (व्यक्ति)
meaning_en: Intractable = hard to control or deal with; Recalcitrant = stubbornly resistant to authority
example: The intractable problem persisted despite all efforts; the recalcitrant student refused to cooperate.

meaning_hi: Judicial = न्यायिक; Judicious = विवेकपूर्ण
meaning_en: Judicial = relating to courts of law; Judicious = having or showing good judgement
example: A judicious use of judicial review can strengthen democratic institutions.

meaning_hi: Laconic = अत्यंत संक्षिप्त; Verbose = अनावश्यक रूप से लंबा
meaning_en: Laconic = using very few words; Verbose = using more words than necessary
example: His laconic reply contrasted starkly with his colleague's verbose explanation.

meaning_hi: Latent = छिपी हुई/अव्यक्त; Patent = स्पष्ट/पेटेंट
meaning_en: Latent = existing but not yet apparent; Patent = obvious or relating to a legal patent
example: Her latent talent became patent to everyone after the competition.

meaning_hi: Later = बाद में (समय); Latter = दूसरा (दो में से)
meaning_en: Later = at a subsequent time; Latter = the second of two mentioned
example: He was offered two posts; he chose the latter and joined later that evening.

meaning_hi: Laud = प्रशंसा करना; Lambaste = तीखी आलोचना करना
meaning_en: Laud = to praise highly; Lambaste = to criticise harshly
example: Critics lauded the film's direction while lambaasting its weak screenplay.

meaning_hi: Laudable = प्रशंसनीय (कार्य); Laudatory = प्रशंसापूर्ण (भाषण/लेख)
meaning_en: Laudable = deserving praise; Laudatory = expressing praise
example: Her laudable effort received a laudatory review in the national press.

meaning_hi: Lay = रखना (सकर्मक-object चाहिए); Lie = लेटना (अकर्मक)
meaning_en: Lay (transitive) = to put something down (needs object); Lie (intransitive) = to recline
example: Lay the patient's file on the desk, then let him lie down on the examination table.

meaning_hi: Libel = लिखित मानहानि; Slander = मौखिक मानहानि
meaning_en: Libel = a written false statement harming reputation; Slander = a spoken false statement
example: He was sued for libel after the article was published, and faced slander charges for remarks at a press conference.

meaning_hi: Licence = अनुमति / लाइसेंस (संज्ञा); License = अनुमति देना (क्रिया)
meaning_en: Licence = an official permit (noun); License = to give official permission (verb)
example: She holds a driving licence; the state will license the new pharmacy next month.

meaning_hi: Loath = अनिच्छुक (adj); Loathe = घृणा करना (verb)
meaning_en: Loath (adjective) = reluctant or unwilling; Loathe (verb) = to feel strong disgust towards
example: He was loath to admit the mistake; he loathed deceit of any kind.

meaning_hi: Loose = ढीला; Lose = खो देना/हारना
meaning_en: Loose (adj/verb) = not tight; Lose (verb) = to be unable to find or to fail to win
example: Do not lose the document; tie it up so the loose pages do not scatter.

meaning_hi: Lucid = स्पष्ट/बोधगम्य; Lucent = चमकीला/प्रकाशमान
meaning_en: Lucid = clearly expressed and easy to understand; Lucent = glowing or shining
example: Her lucid explanation stood in contrast to the lucent lamp that lit the room.

meaning_hi: Luxurious = विलासितापूर्ण; Luxuriant = हरा-भरा / घना
meaning_en: Luxurious = extremely comfortable and expensive; Luxuriant = rich and profuse in growth
example: They stayed in a luxurious hotel surrounded by luxuriant tropical forests.

meaning_hi: Malfeasance = अवैध कार्य (जानबूझकर); Misfeasance = गलत तरीके से किया गया कानूनी कार्य
meaning_en: Malfeasance = wrongdoing especially by a public official; Misfeasance = lawful act done wrongly
example: The officer was charged with malfeasance; the clerk was found guilty of misfeasance.

meaning_hi: Mandatory = कानूनी/आधिकारिक आदेश से अनिवार्य; Compulsory = नियम द्वारा अनिवार्य
meaning_en: Mandatory = required by law or mandate; Compulsory = enforced by rule or necessity
example: Attendance is compulsory in school; wearing a helmet is mandatory under the motor vehicles act.

meaning_hi: Masterful = प्रभावशाली/अधिकारपूर्ण; Masterly = अत्यंत कुशल
meaning_en: Masterful = powerful and commanding; Masterly = performed with great skill
example: He delivered a masterful speech; her masterly brushwork made the painting exceptional.

meaning_hi: Medal = पदक; Meddle = हस्तक्षेप करना
meaning_en: Medal = an award for achievement; Meddle = to interfere in others' affairs
example: She won a gold medal without letting anyone meddle in her training regimen.

meaning_hi: Media = माध्यम (बहुवचन); Medium = एकल माध्यम (एकवचन)
meaning_en: Media = plural of medium (newspapers, TV, etc.); Medium = a single channel or a person claiming to communicate with spirits
example: The media were critical of the decision; television is the most powerful medium in modern times.

meaning_hi: Mendacious = जानबूझकर झूठ बोलने वाला; Fallacious = गलत तर्क पर आधारित
meaning_en: Mendacious = lying and deceitful; Fallacious = based on a false or mistaken belief
example: His mendacious testimony was supported by fallacious reasoning that the jury rejected.

meaning_hi: Mercurial = अस्थिर/जल्दी बदलने वाला स्वभाव; Volatile = अस्थिर/विस्फोटक
meaning_en: Mercurial = subject to sudden unpredictable mood changes; Volatile = liable to change rapidly
example: His mercurial temperament and the volatile market made the partnership risky.

meaning_hi: Meter = मापक यंत्र; Metre = मीटर (लंबाई की माप)
meaning_en: Meter = a measuring device; Metre = a unit of length (100 cm)
example: The electricity meter showed the wire was exactly two metres long.

meaning_hi: Migrant = प्रवासी; Immigrant = देश में आने वाला; Emigrant = देश छोड़ने वाला
meaning_en: Migrant = one who moves; Immigrant = one who enters a new country; Emigrant = one who leaves their country
example: Many emigrants from rural India become migrants in cities; some become immigrants in foreign nations.

meaning_hi: Militate = प्रतिकूल प्रभाव डालना; Mitigate = कम करना
meaning_en: Militate = to have a strong effect against; Mitigate = to make less severe
example: His criminal record militated against his promotion; therapy helped mitigate his aggression.

meaning_hi: Misnomer = गलत नाम; Misconception = गलत धारणा
meaning_en: Misnomer = a wrong or inaccurate name; Misconception = a wrong understanding
example: Calling a koala bear a 'bear' is a misnomer; the misconception persists widely.

meaning_hi: Momentary = क्षणिक; Momentous = महत्वपूर्ण
meaning_en: Momentary = lasting only a moment; Momentous = of great importance
example: There was a momentary silence before the momentous announcement was made.

meaning_hi: Moot = विवादास्पद / बहस योग्य; Mute = चुप/मूक
meaning_en: Moot = open to debate; or a moot point = no longer relevant; Mute = silent or unable to speak
example: Whether the policy was correct is now moot; the minister remained mute on the subject.

meaning_hi: Moral = नैतिक (adj/noun); Morale = मनोबल (noun)
meaning_en: Moral = relating to right and wrong; Morale = confidence and spirit of a group
example: A leader with strong moral values can raise the morale of an entire organisation.

meaning_hi: Morose = उदास/गमगीन; Sullen = रूष्ट/गुस्से में चुप
meaning_en: Morose = gloomy and unsociable; Sullen = showing resentment through silence
example: He grew morose after the setback; the child became sullen when denied the toy.

meaning_hi: Nauseating = मतली दिलाने वाला (बाहरी कारण); Nauseous = मतली महसूस करना (व्यक्ति)
meaning_en: Nauseating = causing nausea in others; Nauseous = feeling sick oneself
example: The nauseating smell of the garbage made her feel nauseous all morning.

meaning_hi: Naval = नौसेना संबंधी; Navel = नाभि
meaning_en: Naval = relating to a navy; Navel = the small hollow on the abdomen
example: The naval officer pointed to his uniform and explained the insignia near the navel of the crest.

meaning_hi: Nefarious = अत्यंत दुष्ट/पापी; Notorious = बदनाम (आम जनता में)
meaning_en: Nefarious = wicked and criminal; Notorious = famous for bad qualities
example: The notorious criminal was known for his nefarious schemes across three states.

meaning_hi: Negate = नकारना/खंडन करना; Nullify = कानूनी रूप से शून्य करना
meaning_en: Negate = to deny or make ineffective; Nullify = to make legally void
example: His confession negated all earlier denials; the court moved to nullify the illegal contract.

meaning_hi: Negligent = लापरवाह; Negligible = नगण्य/बहुत कम
meaning_en: Negligent = failing to take proper care; Negligible = so small as to be unimportant
example: The negligent officer caused negligible damage, but the lapse was serious nonetheless.

meaning_hi: Notable = प्रसिद्ध/उल्लेखनीय (व्यक्ति/बात); Noticeable = स्पष्ट दिखने वाला
meaning_en: Notable = famous or worthy of mention; Noticeable = easily observed or detected
example: The notable improvement in her work was noticeable to everyone in the department.

meaning_hi: Obsequious = चापलूस; Servile = दासता-भरा
meaning_en: Obsequious = excessively eager to please or obey; Servile = having a slave-like mentality
example: His obsequious manner disguised a servile acceptance of every unjust command.

meaning_hi: Obsolescent = धीरे-धीरे पुराना पड़ता हुआ; Obsolete = पूरी तरह प्रचलन से बाहर
meaning_en: Obsolescent = gradually becoming out of date; Obsolete = no longer in use at all
example: The technology is obsolescent now; within five years it will be completely obsolete.

meaning_hi: Officious = अनावश्यक हस्तक्षेप करने वाला; Official = आधिकारिक
meaning_en: Officious = asserting authority beyond one's role; Official = authorised or holding office
example: The officious clerk interfered with the official proceedings unnecessarily.

meaning_hi: Opprobrium = सार्वजनिक निंदा; Obloquy = बदनामी/तिरस्कार
meaning_en: Opprobrium = harsh public censure; Obloquy = strong public condemnation
example: His decisions brought opprobrium from critics and obloquy from the public alike.

meaning_hi: Oral = मौखिक (मुँह से); Verbal = शाब्दिक (शब्दों में—लिखित या मौखिक)
meaning_en: Oral = specifically spoken by mouth; Verbal = relating to words whether spoken or written
example: They made a verbal agreement, but only the oral promise was recorded in the meeting.

meaning_hi: Ostentatious = धन/शक्ति का दिखावा; Pretentious = महत्वपूर्ण दिखने की कोशिश
meaning_en: Ostentatious = showy display of wealth or knowledge; Pretentious = claiming more importance than deserved
example: His ostentatious mansion attracted ridicule; her pretentious literary opinions amused real scholars.

meaning_hi: Overlook = अनदेखा करना; Oversee = निगरानी करना
meaning_en: Overlook = to fail to notice or to pardon; Oversee = to supervise and manage
example: The supervisor was appointed to oversee the project but overlooked several critical errors.

meaning_hi: Panacea = सभी बीमारियों का इलाज; Placebo = मनोवैज्ञानिक दवा (असली नहीं)
meaning_en: Panacea = a solution for all problems; Placebo = a harmless substance with no real effect
example: Education is not a panacea; for some students the attention itself acted as a placebo.

meaning_hi: Paragon = आदर्श व्यक्ति/वस्तु; Paradigm = आदर्श उदाहरण/प्रतिमान
meaning_en: Paragon = a model of excellence; Paradigm = a typical example or model
example: She was regarded as a paragon of integrity; her leadership became a paradigm for others.

meaning_hi: Passed = गुज़रा / पास किया (क्रिया का भूतकाल); Past = अतीत / पहले का
meaning_en: Passed = past tense of 'pass' (verb); Past = a time before the present (noun/adjective)
example: He passed the exam and put his difficult past behind him.

meaning_hi: Patriot = देशभक्त (देश से प्रेम); Nationalist = राष्ट्रवादी (राष्ट्रीय हित पर जोर)
meaning_en: Patriot = one who loves and defends their country; Nationalist = one who promotes national interests, sometimes exclusively
example: A patriot loves their country; a nationalist prioritises national interests above all international cooperation.

meaning_hi: Pedantic = ज्ञान का बेवजह प्रदर्शन; Scholarly = विद्वतापूर्ण
meaning_en: Pedantic = overly focused on minor details; Scholarly = having deep academic knowledge
example: The scholar's work was scholarly yet concise; the critic's response was merely pedantic.

meaning_hi: Penal = दंड संबंधी (कानूनी); Punitive = दंड देने के उद्देश्य से
meaning_en: Penal = relating to punishment by law; Punitive = intended to punish
example: The penal code was revised; the court imposed punitive damages to deter future offences.

meaning_hi: Perfidious = विश्वासघाती; Treacherous = विश्वासघाती/खतरनाक
meaning_en: Perfidious = deceitful and untrustworthy; Treacherous = guilty of betrayal or dangerous
example: His perfidious behaviour made every ally question him; the treacherous mountain path made retreat impossible.

meaning_hi: Persistent = लगातार जारी रहने वाला; Consistent = एकरूप/समान
meaning_en: Persistent = continuing despite difficulty; Consistent = acting the same way over time
example: Her persistent efforts paid off; the scientist needed consistent results across all experiments.

meaning_hi: Personal = व्यक्तिगत; Personnel = कर्मचारी वर्ग
meaning_en: Personal = private or individual; Personnel = the staff or employees of an organisation
example: Keep personal matters separate from work; all army personnel must report by 0800.

meaning_hi: Perspicacious = तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि वाला; Perspicuous = स्पष्ट/आसान समझ में आने वाला
meaning_en: Perspicacious = having sharp insight; Perspicuous = clearly expressed and easy to understand
example: A perspicacious reader understands not just what is written but perspicuous prose makes that easier.

meaning_hi: Phlegmatic = शांत/भावनाशून्य; Sanguine = आशावादी
meaning_en: Phlegmatic = calm and unemotional; Sanguine = optimistic even in difficult situations
example: While she was phlegmatic about the losses, her partner remained sanguine about recovery.

meaning_hi: Pity = तरस (दूरी से); Compassion = करुणा (साथ महसूस करते हुए)
meaning_en: Pity = feeling sorry for someone from a distance; Compassion = deep sympathy accompanied by a desire to help
example: Pity acknowledges suffering; compassion moves one to act in response to it.

meaning_hi: Plain = साधारण / समतल मैदान; Plane = विमान / समतल सतह
meaning_en: Plain (adj/noun) = simple, or flat land; Plane (noun) = an aircraft or flat surface
example: The plane flew over the vast plain below at a perfectly level plane of elevation.

meaning_hi: Plausible = संभव लगने वाला (लेकिन सच न भी हो); Probable = संभावित/होने की संभावना है
meaning_en: Plausible = seeming reasonable; Probable = likely to happen or be true
example: His alibi was plausible; it was probable that he was telling the truth.

meaning_hi: Populace = जनता / आम लोग; Populous = घनी आबादी वाला
meaning_en: Populace = the people of a country or area; Populous = having a large population
example: The populace of the populous city demanded better public transport.

meaning_hi: Practicable = व्यावहारिक रूप से संभव; Practical = व्यावहारिक/उपयोगी
meaning_en: Practicable = capable of being done; Practical = concerned with actual use not theory
example: The plan looked practical on paper, but implementing it was not practicable within the budget.

meaning_hi: Precipitate = अचानक / जल्दबाजी में; Precipitous = खड़ी चट्टान जैसा / अत्यधिक तेज़
meaning_en: Precipitate = done hastily and without consideration; Precipitous = extremely steep or sudden
example: His precipitate decision led to a precipitous fall in the company's share price.

meaning_hi: Prescribe = निर्धारित करना / दवा लिखना; Proscribe = प्रतिबंध लगाना
meaning_en: Prescribe = to recommend officially; Proscribe = to officially forbid
example: The doctor prescribed rest; the law proscribed the drug that had been misused.

meaning_hi: Prevaricate = सच छिपाते हुए बातें घुमाना; Procrastinate = काम टालना
meaning_en: Prevaricate = to evade the truth; Procrastinate = to delay or postpone action
example: He prevaricated during the inquiry and continued to procrastinate on submitting the evidence.

meaning_hi: Principal = प्रधान / मुख्य / प्राचार्य; Principle = सिद्धांत / नियम
meaning_en: Principal = most important, or head of a school; Principle = a fundamental rule or belief
example: The school principal insisted that no compromise on the principle of honesty would be tolerated.

meaning_hi: Prodigal = फ़िज़ूलखर्च / उड़ाऊ; Prodigious = विशाल / असाधारण
meaning_en: Prodigal = wastefully extravagant; Prodigious = remarkably great in size or degree
example: The prodigal heir spent a prodigious sum in just a few months.

meaning_hi: Prophecy = भविष्यवाणी (संज्ञा); Prophesy = भविष्यवाणी करना (क्रिया)
meaning_en: Prophecy = a prediction (noun); Prophesy = to make a prediction (verb)
example: The oracle made a prophecy; she would prophesy the outcome of every battle.

meaning_hi: Propitious = अनुकूल; Auspicious = शुभ
meaning_en: Propitious = giving a good omen or favourable; Auspicious = indicating future success
example: The propitious weather and the auspicious occasion made it a perfect day for the launch.

meaning_hi: Prosecute = मुकदमा चलाना (कानूनी); Persecute = उत्पीड़न करना (अन्याय)
meaning_en: Prosecute = to bring legal proceedings against; Persecute = to subject to prolonged cruelty
example: The government prosecuted the corrupt official; minorities were persecuted under the authoritarian regime.

meaning_hi: Protagonist = नायक/मुख्य पात्र; Antagonist = खलनायक/विरोधी
meaning_en: Protagonist = the main character; Antagonist = the character who opposes the protagonist
example: The novel's protagonist fights for justice; the antagonist represents systemic corruption.

meaning_hi: Provoke = उकसाना/भड़काना; Invoke = आह्वान करना/लागू करना
meaning_en: Provoke = to stimulate a reaction; Invoke = to call on a higher authority or cite a law
example: His speech provoked public anger; the president invoked emergency powers.

meaning_hi: Pugnacious = झगड़ालू स्वभाव वाला; Belligerent = आक्रामक/युद्धप्रिय
meaning_en: Pugnacious = eager to argue or fight; Belligerent = hostile and aggressive
example: The pugnacious negotiator became belligerent when his demands were not met.

meaning_hi: Quandary = दुविधा/असमंजस; Query = प्रश्न/जिज्ञासा
meaning_en: Quandary = a state of uncertainty; Query = a question or doubt
example: His query about the policy put the officer in a quandary about how to respond.

meaning_hi: Quiet = शांत/चुप; Quite = पूरी तरह / काफी हद तक
meaning_en: Quiet = making little or no noise; Quite = completely or to a considerable degree
example: The hall was quite quiet during the examination, exactly as the invigilator required.

meaning_hi: Rain = वर्षा; Reign = शासनकाल; Rein = लगाम / नियंत्रण
meaning_en: Rain = water falling from clouds; Reign = the rule of a monarch; Rein = a strap to control a horse, or to check
example: During the queen's reign, heavy rain disrupted travel; the government kept a tight rein on spending.

meaning_hi: Raise = उठाना (सकर्मक-object चाहिए); Rise = उठना (अकर्मक)
meaning_en: Raise (transitive) = to lift something up; Rise (intransitive) = to move upward by itself
example: Raise your hand before you speak; the sun will rise at six tomorrow.

meaning_hi: Rational = तर्कसंगत / विवेकी; Rationale = औचित्य / कारण
meaning_en: Rational = based on logic and reason; Rationale = the underlying reason or justification
example: Her decision was rational; she explained the rationale clearly in her report.

meaning_hi: Rebuke = कड़ी डाँट; Reprimand = आधिकारिक फटकार
meaning_en: Rebuke = to express sharp disapproval; Reprimand = a formal official expression of disapproval
example: The teacher rebuked the student in class; the officer received an official reprimand from the board.

meaning_hi: Reciprocal = पारस्परिक (बदले में); Mutual = आपसी (दोनों में समान)
meaning_en: Reciprocal = given or felt by both parties in return; Mutual = shared equally between parties
example: The two nations signed a reciprocal trade agreement; they had mutual respect for each other.

meaning_hi: Recondite = अत्यंत गूढ़/दुर्लभ; Esoteric = विशेष व्यक्तियों के लिए
meaning_en: Recondite = obscure and known only to a few; Esoteric = intended for a small specialist audience
example: His recondite research on esoteric rituals attracted only a handful of scholars.

meaning_hi: Redundant = अनावश्यक (अतिरिक्त); Repetitive = बार-बार दोहराव वाला
meaning_en: Redundant = superfluous or no longer needed; Repetitive = done many times in the same way
example: The report was full of redundant clauses; the repetitive exercises became tedious.

meaning_hi: Refute = पूरी तरह खंडन करना (साक्ष्य से); Rebut = तर्क से जवाब देना
meaning_en: Refute = to prove wrong conclusively; Rebut = to counter an argument
example: He refuted the charge with documented evidence; the minister rebutted the opposition's claim.

meaning_hi: Reluctant = अनिच्छुक (कार्य करने में); Reticent = कम बोलने वाला
meaning_en: Reluctant = unwilling to do something; Reticent = not revealing one's thoughts readily
example: He was reluctant to speak publicly and remained reticent even in private conversations.

meaning_hi: Renounce = त्यागना; Denounce = सार्वजनिक रूप से निंदा करना
meaning_en: Renounce = to give up formally; Denounce = to publicly condemn
example: He renounced his citizenship; world leaders denounced the invasion.

meaning_hi: Replete = पूर्ण/भरपूर; Deplete = खाली करना/घटाना
meaning_en: Replete = filled to the full; Deplete = to reduce greatly in quantity
example: The warehouse was replete with supplies before the crisis depleted them within a week.

meaning_hi: Resilient = लचीला (वापस उठने में सक्षम); Resistant = प्रतिरोधी
meaning_en: Resilient = able to recover quickly; Resistant = opposing or withstanding
example: The resilient community rebuilt after the disaster; the bacteria were resistant to antibiotics.

meaning_hi: Respectful = सम्मानपूर्ण; Respective = अपने-अपने (अलग-अलग)
meaning_en: Respectful = showing politeness and respect; Respective = belonging separately to each
example: All participants returned to their respective seats and maintained a respectful silence.

meaning_hi: Restive = अशांत (नियंत्रण न मानने से); Restless = बेचैन (स्थिर न रह सकने से)
meaning_en: Restive = unwilling to be controlled; Restless = unable to rest or keep still
example: The restive crowd became restless as the delay continued past midnight.

meaning_hi: Retort = तीखा पलटवार; Resort = आश्रय/सहारा/पर्यटन स्थल
meaning_en: Retort = a sharp reply; Resort (noun) = a place or course of action; (verb) = to turn to
example: She made a witty retort; when diplomacy failed, both sides resorted to confrontation.

meaning_hi: Revoke = रद्द करना; Evoke = उभारना/स्मृति जगाना
meaning_en: Revoke = to officially cancel; Evoke = to bring to mind
example: The court revoked the order; the painting evoked memories of his childhood.

meaning_hi: Right = सही / दायाँ; Write = लिखना; Rite = धार्मिक अनुष्ठान
meaning_en: Right = correct or direction; Write = to form words; Rite = a religious or ceremonial act
example: Write the right name of the rite performed at the ceremony in the application form.

meaning_hi: Rigorous = कठोर/सख्त; Vigorous = जोरदार/ऊर्जावान
meaning_en: Rigorous = extremely thorough and strict; Vigorous = strong and energetic
example: The rigorous training programme produced vigorous athletes.
