meaning_hi: Rival = प्रतिद्वंद्वी (प्रतिस्पर्धा में); Adversary = शत्रु/विपक्षी
meaning_en: Rival = a competitor; Adversary = an enemy or opponent
example: The two companies are business rivals; in court, each side's adversary fought hard.

meaning_hi: Sanctimonious = ढोंगी/दिखावटी धार्मिक; Pious = सच्चा धार्मिक
meaning_en: Sanctimonious = making a show of being morally superior; Pious = genuinely devout
example: The pious villager was offended by the sanctimonious preaching of the visiting speaker.

meaning_hi: Sanction = अनुमोदन/प्रतिबंध; Sanctify = पवित्र करना
meaning_en: Sanction (noun/verb) = official permission or a penalty; Sanctify = to make holy
example: The UN imposed sanctions; the ceremony was held to sanctify the new building.

meaning_hi: Sardonic = कटु/व्यंग्यात्मक (अंदरूनी); Sarcastic = व्यंग्यात्मक (स्पष्ट रूप से)
meaning_en: Sardonic = grimly mocking; Sarcastic = using irony to mock openly
example: His sardonic smile suggested contempt; her sarcastic remark left no room for misinterpretation.

meaning_hi: Scrupulous = सुविवेकी/ईमानदार; Unscrupulous = बेईमान
meaning_en: Scrupulous = careful and principled; Unscrupulous = without moral principles
example: The scrupulous auditor exposed the unscrupulous practices in the organisation's accounts.

meaning_hi: Secular = धर्मनिरपेक्ष; Sectarian = सांप्रदायिक
meaning_en: Secular = not concerned with religion; Sectarian = relating to a particular sect, often divisively
example: India's constitution is secular; sectarian violence threatens social harmony.

meaning_hi: Sedulous = परिश्रमी/लगनशील; Assiduous = अत्यंत मेहनती
meaning_en: Sedulous = showing dedication and diligence; Assiduous = working with great care and persistence
example: His sedulous approach and assiduous attention to detail made him the most trusted researcher.

meaning_hi: Sensible = समझदार; Sensitive = संवेदनशील
meaning_en: Sensible = showing practical good sense; Sensitive = easily affected by emotions or stimuli
example: She was sensible enough to know that her colleague was sensitive about the topic.

meaning_hi: Sensual = कामुक (इंद्रिय सुख — अक्सर यौन); Sensuous = इंद्रियों को आनंददायक (गैर-यौन)
meaning_en: Sensual = relating to physical gratification; Sensuous = appealing to the senses in an aesthetic way
example: Keats's poetry is sensuous; his novel was criticised for its sensual overtones.

meaning_hi: Simulate = नकल करना/अनुकरण करना; Stimulate = उत्तेजित/प्रोत्साहित करना
meaning_en: Simulate = to imitate or reproduce a situation; Stimulate = to encourage or activate
example: The pilot used a simulator; the government's policy stimulated economic growth.

meaning_hi: Sit = बैठना (अकर्मक); Set = रखना (सकर्मक)
meaning_en: Sit (intransitive) = to be seated; Set (transitive) = to put something in place
example: Please sit in the chair and set the papers on the table.

meaning_hi: Sociable = मिलनसार (व्यक्ति); Social = सामाजिक (समाज से संबंधित)
meaning_en: Sociable = enjoying the company of others; Social = relating to society
example: She is a sociable person; the government launched a new social welfare programme.

meaning_hi: Solicitous = चिंतित/सेवाभावी; Solipsistic = अत्यधिक आत्मकेंद्रित
meaning_en: Solicitous = showing care and concern for others; Solipsistic = absorbed only in oneself
example: She was solicitous about everyone's welfare; he was too solipsistic to notice others' needs.

meaning_hi: Spurious = नकली/झूठा; Specious = देखने में सही पर असल में गलत
meaning_en: Spurious = not genuine; Specious = superficially plausible but actually wrong
example: The document was spurious; the argument for using it was specious.

meaning_hi: Stationary = स्थिर/न हिलने वाला; Stationery = लेखन सामग्री
meaning_en: Stationary = not moving; Stationery = writing and office materials
example: The stationery van remained stationary outside the school for over an hour.

meaning_hi: Stolid = अनुद्वेगी/निर्भाव; Stoic = धैर्यवान (कठिनाई में भी)
meaning_en: Stolid = calm and showing little emotion; Stoic = enduring hardship without complaint
example: The stolid judge and the stoic prisoner both remained expressionless throughout the trial.

meaning_hi: Strident = कठोर/तेज़ आवाज; Shrill = तीखी/ऊँची आवाज
meaning_en: Strident = loud, harsh and forceful; Shrill = high-pitched and piercing
example: The strident protests outside and the shrill cry of the alarm made the hearing impossible.

meaning_hi: Stringent = अत्यंत कड़ा (नियम/शर्त); Strict = सख्त (व्यक्ति/अनुशासन)
meaning_en: Stringent = rigorous and precise; Strict = demanding adherence to rules
example: The stringent regulations required careful compliance; the strict teacher accepted no excuses.

meaning_hi: Subjective = व्यक्तिपरक (राय पर आधारित); Objective = वस्तुपरक (तथ्य पर आधारित)
meaning_en: Subjective = based on personal opinion; Objective = based on facts independent of opinion
example: Aesthetic judgement is subjective; scientific measurement must be objective.

meaning_hi: Subsequently = बाद में / तत्पश्चात; Consequently = फलस्वरूप / इसलिए
meaning_en: Subsequently = coming after something in time; Consequently = as a result of
example: He lost the contract; consequently, the firm suffered; subsequently it had to downsize.

meaning_hi: Suit = कोट-पतलून / अनुकूल होना; Suite = कमरों का समूह / संगीत श्रृंखला
meaning_en: Suit (noun/verb) = a set of clothes, or to be convenient; Suite = connected rooms or musical pieces
example: He wore his finest suit to the presidential suite where the negotiations were being held.

meaning_hi: Supine = चित लेटा हुआ (मुँह ऊपर) / निष्क्रिय; Prone = औंधा लेटा हुआ (मुँह नीचे) / प्रवण
meaning_en: Supine = lying face upward, or passive; Prone = lying face downward, or likely to do something
example: The patient was placed supine on the stretcher; she is prone to making rash decisions.

meaning_hi: Suppress = दबाना (बाहरी शक्ति से); Repress = मन में दबाना (मनोवैज्ञानिक)
meaning_en: Suppress = to put down by force or prevent from being known; Repress = to suppress within oneself
example: The government suppressed the protest; he repressed his anger until it erupted unexpectedly.

meaning_hi: Susceptible = प्रभावित होने की आशंका; Vulnerable = कमज़ोर/रक्षाहीन
meaning_en: Susceptible = likely to be affected; Vulnerable = exposed to harm or attack
example: Elderly people are susceptible to infections; children in conflict zones are particularly vulnerable.

meaning_hi: Sycophantic = चापलूस (स्वार्थ के लिए); Obsequious = अत्यधिक विनम्र
meaning_en: Sycophantic = using flattery for personal gain; Obsequious = servilely compliant
example: The sycophantic aide and the obsequious secretary both competed for the minister's favour.

meaning_hi: Systematic = व्यवस्थित/योजनाबद्ध; Systemic = पूरी प्रणाली में व्याप्त
meaning_en: Systematic = done according to a plan; Systemic = affecting an entire system
example: He made a systematic study of the data; the problem of corruption is systemic, not isolated.

meaning_hi: Tacit = मौन-सम्मति (बिना बोले); Taciturn = कम बोलने वाला (स्वभाव से)
meaning_en: Tacit = understood without being stated; Taciturn = reserved and rarely speaking
example: There was a tacit understanding between them; both were taciturn by nature.

meaning_hi: Tactics = अल्पकालिक युक्ति; Strategy = दीर्घकालिक रणनीति
meaning_en: Tactics = specific actions in the short term; Strategy = an overall long-term plan
example: The general's tactics secured the battle; his strategy ultimately won the war.

meaning_hi: Temporal = सांसारिक/समय-संबंधी; Temporary = अस्थायी
meaning_en: Temporal = relating to worldly affairs or time; Temporary = lasting only for a limited period
example: The Church distinguished between temporal and spiritual power; the arrangement was only temporary.

meaning_hi: Tenuous = कमज़ोर/अस्थिर; Tedious = थकाऊ/उबाऊ
meaning_en: Tenuous = very weak or thin; Tedious = too long and slow
example: The tenuous connection between the suspects made the tedious investigation even longer.

meaning_hi: Terse = संक्षिप्त (नकारात्मक नहीं); Curt = रूखा संक्षिप्त (अशिष्ट)
meaning_en: Terse = brief and to the point; Curt = rudely brief
example: His terse reply conveyed the decision clearly; her curt dismissal offended the entire team.

meaning_hi: Than = से (तुलना में); Then = तब / उसके बाद
meaning_en: Than = used in comparisons; Then = at that time, or next in sequence
example: She scored higher than expected, and then received the news of her selection.

meaning_hi: Their = उनका; There = वहाँ; They're = वे हैं
meaning_en: Their = belonging to them; There = at that place; They're = contraction of they are
example: They're on their way; their car should be there within the hour.

meaning_hi: Thorough = पूर्ण/संपूर्ण; Through = के माध्यम से; Threw = फेंका (भूतकाल)
meaning_en: Thorough = complete and careful; Through = from one end to the other; Threw = past of throw
example: She threw the ball through the thorough inspection corridor without being stopped.

meaning_hi: Tirade = लंबा भाषण (क्रोध में); Diatribe = तीखी/कठोर आलोचना
meaning_en: Tirade = a long angry speech; Diatribe = a forceful verbal attack
example: His tirade in parliament escalated into a diatribe against the entire opposition.

meaning_hi: Tortuous = टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा / पेचीदा; Torturous = अत्यंत कष्टदायक
meaning_en: Tortuous = winding and full of twists; Torturous = causing great pain or suffering
example: The tortuous mountain road made the torturous journey even more exhausting.

meaning_hi: Transgress = नियम का उल्लंघन करना; Trespass = अनधिकृत प्रवेश करना
meaning_en: Transgress = to go beyond a boundary or rule; Trespass = to enter land without permission
example: He transgressed every ethical guideline and trespassed on private property to gather evidence.

meaning_hi: Translucent = अर्धपारदर्शी (प्रकाश आता है पर दृश्य नहीं); Transparent = पूरी तरह पारदर्शी
meaning_en: Translucent = allowing light to pass but not a clear view; Transparent = clear, allowing full visibility
example: Frosted glass is translucent; the organisation pledged transparent governance.

meaning_hi: Travesty = किसी चीज़ की विकृत नकल; Parody = हास्यपूर्ण अनुकरण
meaning_en: Travesty = a false, distorted representation of something; Parody = a humorous imitation
example: The rushed trial was a travesty of justice; the comedian's parody of it went viral.

meaning_hi: Treachery = विश्वासघात; Treason = राजद्रोह (राज्य के विरुद्ध)
meaning_en: Treachery = betrayal of trust; Treason = the crime of betraying one's country
example: His treachery cost the team the match; passing secrets to the enemy constitutes treason.

meaning_hi: Turbid = मटमैला/गंदला (तरल); Turgid = फूला हुआ / अत्यधिक जटिल (लेखन)
meaning_en: Turbid = cloudy or muddy (liquid); Turgid = swollen or pompously dull in style
example: The river water was turbid after the flood; his turgid prose made the report equally murky.

meaning_hi: Turbulence = उथलपुथल (हवा/पानी/वातावरण); Turmoil = अशांति/उथलपुथल (मन/समाज)
meaning_en: Turbulence = irregular motion in air or water; Turmoil = a state of great confusion
example: The flight encountered turbulence; the country was in political turmoil.

meaning_hi: Ubiquitous = सर्वत्र मौजूद (मानव-निर्मित); Omnipresent = सर्वव्यापी (ईश्वर/बड़े प्रभाव के लिए)
meaning_en: Ubiquitous = seeming to appear everywhere; Omnipresent = present everywhere at all times
example: The mobile phone is ubiquitous; believers consider God omnipresent.

meaning_hi: Ultimate = अंतिम; Penultimate = अंतिम से एक पहले
meaning_en: Ultimate = last or final; Penultimate = second to last
example: The ultimate decision rested with the board; the penultimate round was the most competitive.

meaning_hi: Unaware = अनजान (adjective); Unawares = अचानक/अप्रत्याशित रूप से (adverb)
meaning_en: Unaware (adj) = not knowing; Unawares (adverb) = unexpectedly or by surprise
example: She was completely unaware of the plan and it caught her unawares during the meeting.

meaning_hi: Unctuous = चिकनी-चुपड़ी बातें करने वाला; Obsequious = चापलूस
meaning_en: Unctuous = excessively flattering in an insincere way; Obsequious = excessively compliant
example: His unctuous praise and obsequious manner did not fool the shrewd interviewer.

meaning_hi: Undo = पूर्ववत करना / खोलना; Undue = अनुचित / अत्यधिक
meaning_en: Undo = to reverse an action or untie; Undue = more than is reasonable or appropriate
example: There is no way to undo the damage caused by undue haste.

meaning_hi: Universal = सार्वभौमिक (सभी के लिए); General = सामान्य (अधिकांश के लिए)
meaning_en: Universal = applying to all cases without exception; General = applying to most cases
example: Human rights are universal; the general trend was positive despite some exceptions.

meaning_hi: Urban = शहरी; Urbane = सभ्य/शिष्ट
meaning_en: Urban = relating to a city or town; Urbane = suave, polite and refined in manner
example: The urbane diplomat navigated the complex urban political landscape with ease.

meaning_hi: Vacillate = अनिर्णय में डोलना; Oscillate = आगे-पीछे हिलना
meaning_en: Vacillate = to waver between different opinions; Oscillate = to swing back and forth
example: He vacillated between two careers while the market continued to oscillate unpredictably.

meaning_hi: Vague = अस्पष्ट (जानकारी का अभाव); Ambiguous = दो या अधिक अर्थ वाला
meaning_en: Vague = unclear due to lack of detail; Ambiguous = open to more than one interpretation
example: His answer was vague and uninformative; the clause was ambiguous and could be read two ways.

meaning_hi: Vain = घमंडी/व्यर्थ; Vane = दिशा सूचक पंख; Vein = नस/रक्तवाहिनी
meaning_en: Vain = excessively proud, or fruitless; Vane = weather device; Vein = blood vessel
example: The vain politician could not read the weather vane; his schemes ran through the body politic like a diseased vein.

meaning_hi: Valid = वैध (तार्किक/कानूनी रूप से); Legitimate = न्यायसंगत/कानूनी रूप से उचित
meaning_en: Valid = acceptable on logical or legal grounds; Legitimate = conforming to law or accepted rules
example: The argument was valid; the question of legitimate authority was debated in parliament.

meaning_hi: Vapid = नीरस/जीवनहीन; Insipid = बेस्वाद/नीरस
meaning_en: Vapid = offering nothing stimulating; Insipid = lacking flavour or interest
example: The vapid speech was as insipid as the lukewarm tea served at the event.

meaning_hi: Vary = भिन्न होना/बदलना (क्रिया); Very = बहुत (क्रिया विशेषण)
meaning_en: Vary (verb) = to change or be different; Very (adverb) = to a high degree
example: Prices vary with demand; the very idea of fixed pricing is very unpopular with traders.

meaning_hi: Venal = भ्रष्ट/रिश्वती; Venial = क्षमा योग्य (छोटी गलती)
meaning_en: Venal = willing to act dishonestly for money; Venial = a minor sin that can be forgiven
example: A venal officer cannot be forgiven, but a venial mistake by a new recruit deserves leniency.

meaning_hi: Veracious = सत्यवादी; Voracious = अत्यधिक भूख वाला/लालची
meaning_en: Veracious = truthful; Voracious = having a huge appetite for food or knowledge
example: A veracious journalist with a voracious appetite for facts is a democracy's best friend.

meaning_hi: Vicarious = दूसरे के माध्यम से अनुभव किया गया; Vicariously = परोक्ष रूप से
meaning_en: Vicarious = experienced through another's actions; Vicariously = in a secondary or indirect way
example: Parents often live vicariously through their children, experiencing vicarious achievement.

meaning_hi: Vigilant = सतर्क (खतरे पर निगरानी); Wary = सावधान (भरोसा न करते हुए)
meaning_en: Vigilant = keeping careful watch; Wary = cautious and suspicious
example: The guard was vigilant throughout the night; she was wary of strangers at the door.

meaning_hi: Vindicate = सही साबित करना; Exonerate = आरोपमुक्त करना
meaning_en: Vindicate = to clear from blame and prove correct; Exonerate = to officially absolve from blame
example: The inquiry vindicated his decision; the court exonerated him of all charges.

meaning_hi: Virtue = सद्गुण/नैतिक गुण; Virtuosity = कलात्मक निपुणता
meaning_en: Virtue = moral excellence; Virtuosity = great skill in a technical area, especially music
example: Honesty is a virtue; the violinist's virtuosity left the audience breathless.

meaning_hi: Waist = कमर; Waste = व्यर्थ करना/कचरा
meaning_en: Waist = the part of the body between ribs and hips; Waste (verb/noun) = to squander
example: She tightened the belt around her waist and resolved never to waste another opportunity.

meaning_hi: Waive = अधिकार छोड़ना; Wave = लहर / हाथ हिलाना
meaning_en: Waive = to give up a right or claim; Wave = a ridge of water, or to move the hand as a greeting
example: She agreed to waive the late fee and gave a friendly wave as she left the office.

meaning_hi: Wander = भटकना / इधर-उधर घूमना; Wonder = आश्चर्य / जिज्ञासा
meaning_en: Wander = to walk without a fixed route; Wonder = to feel curious or amazed
example: She wandered through the forest, wondering at its incredible beauty.

meaning_hi: Wane = घटना/कम होना; Wax = बढ़ना/बड़ा होना
meaning_en: Wane = to decrease gradually; Wax = to increase gradually
example: His influence began to wane; public interest in the issue waxed following the controversy.

meaning_hi: Wary = सावधान/सतर्क; Weary = थका हुआ/ऊबा हुआ
meaning_en: Wary = cautious due to suspicion; Weary = tired from exertion
example: Be wary of misleading claims; she was weary after the long journey.

meaning_hi: Weak = कमज़ोर; Week = सप्ताह
meaning_en: Weak = lacking strength; Week = a period of seven days
example: He was still weak from illness but returned to work after a week of rest.

meaning_hi: Weather = मौसम; Whether = क्या/यदि (विकल्प दिखाना)
meaning_en: Weather = atmospheric conditions; Whether = introducing doubt or a condition
example: Whether the weather improves or not, the outdoor event will proceed as planned.

meaning_hi: Whimsical = मनोरंजक/सनकी (प्रसन्न रूप में); Capricious = मनमाना/अस्थिर
meaning_en: Whimsical = playfully fanciful; Capricious = given to sudden unpredictable changes
example: Her whimsical drawings contrasted with her capricious mood that changed every hour.

meaning_hi: Who's = कौन है (contraction of who is/has); Whose = किसका (possessive)
meaning_en: Who's = contraction of 'who is' or 'who has'; Whose = belonging to whom
example: Whose report is this? And who's responsible for the errors it contains?

meaning_hi: Willful = जानबूझकर/हठी; Willing = तैयार/इच्छुक
meaning_en: Willful = deliberate and obstinate; Willing = ready to do something without objection
example: The willful destruction of property is an offence; the volunteers were willing to help.

meaning_hi: Wither = मुरझाना/सूखना; Writhe = दर्द में तड़पना
meaning_en: Wither = to dry up and shrink; Writhe = to twist in pain
example: The flowers withered in the drought; the patient writhed in pain before the medicine took effect.

meaning_hi: Xenophobia = विदेशियों से डर/घृणा; Xenophilia = विदेशी संस्कृति से प्रेम
meaning_en: Xenophobia = fear or hatred of foreigners; Xenophilia = attraction to foreign cultures
example: His xenophilia for foreign art stood in contrast to the xenophobia spreading in his town.

meaning_hi: Yeoman = किसान/सेवक (ऐतिहासिक); Yearn = तड़पना
meaning_en: Yeoman = a freeholder or servant of historical times; Yearn = to have a strong desire
example: The yeoman did yeoman service for the cause he yearned to see succeed.

meaning_hi: Yoke = जुआ/बोझ; Yolk = अंडे की जर्दी
meaning_en: Yoke = a wooden frame joining animals, or a burden; Yolk = the yellow centre of an egg
example: The farmer placed the yoke on the oxen and ate a boiled egg, separating the yolk carefully.

meaning_hi: Zeal = उत्साह (सकारात्मक); Zealotry = कट्टरपंथ (अतिरिक्त)
meaning_en: Zeal = great energy and enthusiasm for a cause; Zealotry = excessive and fanatical enthusiasm
example: Her zeal for reform was admirable; it never crossed the dangerous line into zealotry.

meaning_hi: Zealous = उत्साही/जोशीला; Jealous = ईर्ष्यालु
meaning_en: Zealous = filled with great zeal; Jealous = feeling envy or fear of losing
example: She was zealous in her duties and jealous of her hard-earned reputation.
